And then finally, the Secretary of Defense is forcing wokeness training on everybody on active duty.” Bottom Line: “ Secretary Austin, General Milley, and others claim DEI (diversity, equity, and inclusion) initiatives will improve battlefield performance, but closer scrutiny of these claims reveal they are building their entire DEI agenda on a foundation of fringe history and shoddy social science. In order to prevent, and if necessary win, wars in the 21st century, the U.S. military must remain a colorblind meritocracy free from radical identity politics and laser-focused on warfighting.” RUSSIA–UKRAINE TENSIONS Bottom Line: “Russia has officially kicked off the main phase of huge joint military exercises in Belarus, as Western countries continue to warn Russian forces massing near Ukraine could be used to launch a possible attack. Russia has poured an unprecedented number of troops and equipment into Belarus over recent weeks ahead of the 10-day drills, moving units almost 6,000 miles from its far east and deploying tanks, long-range artillery and advanced fighter jets.” Thank you for reading this month’s edition of the Foreign Policy Newsletter –– we’ll be in touch soon as we monitor developing stories from around the globe.** –– Gallagher Foreign Policy HQ | | | | | Paid for by Mike Gallagher for Wisconsin. | | P.O. | | By now, you know that our congressional district boundaries are changing here in New Jersey and across the nation due to redistricting. **I've heard a lot of questions about where the new Third Congressional District is, and what it means for our upcoming 2022 election.** For starters, the district won't officially change until January. I'll continue to work hard for folks in Burlington and Ocean counties every single day. Come November, we'll be voting according to the new district lines. The new Third District will no longer encompass Ocean County. It will continue to include almost all of Burlington County. It will extend northward to parts of Mercer County, and will stretch northeast into parts of Monmouth County. **I've been thinking of this new district as being right in "the heart of New Jersey" — which is great since my heart is always in New Jersey.** This state is one that gave my family everything, and I'm now raising my two boys a few miles from where I grew up. New Jersey is home to Bruce Springsteen, Jon Bon Jovi, and the best beaches and boardwalks in America. When I'm away from home, I dream of waking up and finding a good pork roll, egg, and cheese. Of course, with over 320,000 new people in our district, I'm looking forward to getting to know so many more of our neighbors. clean_body: | | | By now, you know that our congressional district boundaries are changing here in New Jersey and across the nation due to redistricting. I've heard a lot of questions about where the new Third Congressional District is, and what it means for our upcoming 2022 election. For starters, the district won't officially change until January. I'll continue to work hard for folks in Burlington and Ocean counties every single day. Come November, we'll be voting according to the new district lines. The new Third District will no longer encompass Ocean County. It will continue to include almost all of Burlington County. It will extend northward to parts of Mercer County, and will stretch northeast into parts of Monmouth County. I've been thinking of this new district as being right in "the heart of New Jersey" — which is great since my heart is always in New Jersey. This state is one that gave my family everything, and I'm now raising my two boys a few miles from where I grew up. New Jersey is home to Bruce Springsteen, Jon Bon Jovi, and the best beaches and boardwalks in America. When I'm away from home, I dream of waking up and finding a good pork roll, egg, and cheese. Of course, with over 320,000 new people in our district, I'm looking forward to getting to know so many more of our neighbors. And that means we are going to have to once again build a colossal organizing program with volunteers, organizers, and interns. = We have a lot of work to do and this team is already working hard every single day. = = Happy Valentine's Day! Friend,

While I’m not myself up for reelection for a number of years, I’m absolutely dedicated to helping Republicans win back both the Senate majority and the majority in the U.S. House.

When I come across promising candidates for office, I make a concerted effort to do everything I personally can to help them succeed. That’s why today I’m excited to endorse Mr. Rod Dorilás for Congress.

**Rod’s Dorilás’ story is quintessentially American.** His Haitian immigrant parents came to the United States without a penny to their name; to make a living they picked crops in South Florida. With hard work and a lot of perseverance, they found their own American Dream and became small business owners. And less than forty years after first arriving in the United States, their son – Rod – had the distinct honor of serving the president of the United States.

I’m proud to support the son of entrepreneurial immigrants who built their own American Dream without the help of the government, or socialist-style handouts. **Perhaps with more dedicated public servants such as Rod Dorilás in Congress, grit, determination and personal responsibility may finally win out over the left’s mantra of “give me give me give me.”**

clean_body: Last week, Business Insider and SF Gate each published profiles of our 2022 campaign, and our continuing efforts to expose Pelosi’s wide-ranging corruption and offer San Francisco a more sincere voice to represent our city in Congress. Business Insider pa | | | | | Dear Peter, Happy Valentine's Day! I tend to think of Valentine's Day as a commercial contrivance—but to the extent social justice is love in public, I approach the day as an excuse to redouble our efforts. Did you happen to notice our press appearances last week? They included repeated segments on KTVU (a local television news station), as well as a extended Q&A; in SF Gate , reaching a larger local audience than any publication in which we've been featured so far. It was syndicated by newspapers from Southern California to New Jersey, while our profile in Business Insider also inspired a story in Business & Politics Wire, as well as two other appearances in Business Insider over the course of the week. Please take a minute to read our profile in Business Insider , and the Q&A; with SF Gate that has driven so much discussion of our campaign in the past week. Would you be willing to share those stories with others who share our concerns? Clicking on either of the thumbnails below will take you to them. Thanks for your support—and happy Valentine's Day, once again! Shahid \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Shahid Buttar Date: Thur, Feb 10, 2022 at 3:45 PM Subject: Waging war on the Democratic Party’s corruption Dear Peter, While every day on the campaign trail is different from the next, one thing that seems to remain true in politics is that things change quickly. We’re grateful this week to stand in a remarkably different position than we did only just a few weeks ago, when many observers still falsely presumed that Pelosi would retire, creating an open seat. The various career politicians described as her potential replacements in the press are all committed to their careers before the issues, which is why none of them are willing to face the incumbent. Earlier this week, Business Insider published a profile about me and our 2022 campaign observing our long history of calling out conflicts of interest, particularly insider trading by Members of Congress. The article explores congressional insider trading, quoting me as saying, “She spent 34 years enriching herself at the public's expense. And this is how.” While Buttar...said he's glad the rest of the world has finally caught up, he's also apoplectic that it took everyone so long. He called Pelosi out about her finances in April 2021, inquiring on social media whether she was serving "her constituents or her $140-million portfolio." "This is unapologetic, open corruption," Buttar said.... "It's a conflict of interest that invites corporate influence into their substantive decision making," he said of the status quo, casting the fossil fuels distributors, drug makers, and defense contractors packed into lawmakers' financial portfolios as powerful puppeteers. "Members of Congress are more committed to those industries than their constituents precisely because they make money off it," Buttar said. "It is that simple." Then, just this morning, SF Gate published a profile and lengthy Q&A; making clear our position vis-a-vis the Democratic Party. The SF Gate story was notable for several reasons. First, it reviews long suppressed by San Francisco journalists aligned with the Democratic Party, exposing a smear campaign orchestrated to insulate an oligarch from public accountability. It also featured our critique of the incumbent, and the better alternatives that we offer on policy issues. SF Gate quoted me as saying: [D]o voters want the same voice that has steered our country into a ditch for 34 years while filling her pockets at the public's expense? Or do we want an advocate who has long stood for our communities? Plenty of people who've stood for our communities get smeared. Ilhan Omar is smeared routinely. Dr. King got smeared. Malcolm X got smeared. If you stand for truth against an establishment, you get smeared. They only smear you if they fear you. And the Democratic establishment has good reason to fear me because on six different occasions in 2020 I won things bigger than a congressional seat: We shifted the speaker of the House on critical policy issues. While many voters have grown disillusioned with the voices of politicians who claim support for progressive principles when convenient, SF Gate also highlighted what makes me different than every politician in Washington: I'm not afraid of a fight. I mean, they've done everything short of killing me to shut me up. Every kind of lie you could imagine, leveraging racial stereotypes and religious stereotypes.... [I]n 2022, I understand that I have to run against [Pelosi], the party, and all of its sycophants in institutions, sadly, including the press. Power concedes nothing without a demand. I’ve always been willing to make the demands, but their force and strength depends on your support. That’s why, together, we were able to force change on the House of Representatives in 2020 on six major policy issues. With your continued help, I’m confident that similar success is the least we can expect in 2022. As I’m fond of saying, I’m happy to continue pushing Pelosi on policy issues...until we push her out of her seat. Thanks so much for standing with me! * * *
**National Week of Training**
Wisconsin GOP Victory staff joined the National Week of Training to hold events, meet with supporters, and train conservatives in the nuts-and-bolts of voter contact!
**Pepin County Pints and Politics**
Pepin County Republicans hosted a Pints and Politics event featuring remarks from Senator Ron Johnson!
**Monroe County Lincoln Day Dinner**
Monroe County Republicans gathered for their annual Lincoln Day Dinner featuring speakers including WisGOP Chairman Paul Farrow, Third Congressional District Candidate Derrick Van Orden, local elected officials and candidates, and statewide candidates!
**Brown County Caucus**
The Republican Party of Brown County held their annual County Caucus with a record attendance.
**Washington County Meet-and-Greet**
Washington County Republican Women hosted a meet-and-greet event for area conservative women to share their thoughts with local candidates and elected officials.
**Vilas County Caucus**
Vilas County Republicans held their annual County Caucus with speakers like Congressman Tom Tiffany!
**Green County Caucus**
Green County Republicans hosted their well-attended annual County Caucus in Monroe! Speakers included legislators, statewide candidates, and WisGOP Chairman Paul Farrow, who reminded guests to work hard, unite, and win this election cycle!
**Winnebago County Pints and Politics**
Winnebago County Republicans enjoyed remarks from local candidates and county party leadership at their Pints and Politics event.
**Washington County Caucus and Lincoln Day Dinner**
It was a packed house at the annual Washington County Caucus and Lincoln Day Dinner!
**Outagamie County Caucus**
Outagamie County Republicans' annual County Caucus was a packed house!
**Sawyer County Lincoln Day Dinner**
Sawyer County Republicans hosted an at-capacity crowd for their annual Lincoln Day Dinner featuring remarks from speakers like Congressman Tom Tiffany, state legislators, and statewide candidates!
**Dodge County Caucus**
Members of the Dodge County Republican Party gathered for their annual County Caucus and heard from speakers.
**Eau Claire County Lincoln Day Dinner**
Eau Claire County conservatives gathered for their annual Lincoln Day Dinner!
**Price County Lincoln Day Dinner**
The Republican Party of Price County hosted nine speakers for their Lincoln Day Dinner event.

body:
[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/46?t=1001&akid=2347%2E3611125%2ELT2Esq ][IMG]

Folks,

According to my pollsters, we’ll lose this race unless we launch TV ads as
early as possible.

Here’s why: If Republicans attack me on the airwaves before I get a chance
to introduce myself to Ohioans, we’re toast. They’ll launch nasty ad
blitzes, spread vicious lies, and do whatever they can to trick voters
into thinking I’m someone I’m not.

It’s a lot harder to change someone’s mind once they’ve seen a negative
first impression. So we need to raise $100,000 by midnight tomorrow to get
our TV ads up BEFORE the Republicans come after me. But we’re falling
dangerously behind and I’m nervous.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/7469?t=1015&amount=25&akid=2347%2E3611125%2ELT2Esq ]I’m counting on grassroots supporters like you to help me set the
record straight. Will you chip in $25 to get our ads on the air so we can
win this battleground race and expand our Democratic Senate majority?

I’ve heard the insults Republicans are hurling my way, and they aren’t
exactly clever.

Trump called me a “disaster” who is “laughed at.” JD Vance says I’m a
“fraud” who “pretends to care.” Josh Mandel is telling folks I’m “soggy”
with “marshmallow hands”—whatever that means.

I’m not scared of their schoolyard bully tactics. But Republicans are
already spending $56 million to keep Ohio red, and they have millions that
they’ll spend dragging my name through the mud from now until Election
Day.

I am really worried that we won’t raise the funds we need to get our ads

Friends,

Welcome back to the “Weekly Wyoming Wrap-Up.” Harriet continues traveling the state to visit with her fellow Wyomingites about the issues that we are facing. All of us in Wyoming are concerned about the chaos in Washington, the failing democrat agenda, and the way these failures impact our daily lives.
Stay tuned for exciting announcements about upcoming events across Wyoming!

For Wyoming,

Team Hageman
---
**Around Wyoming**
Harriet traveled to Worland for the Agar bull sale, stopping by Maggie’s Café for an early breakfast. Harriet is remarkably familiar with the Worland area, having spent seven years in a legal battle against the EPA and Army Corps of Engineers fighting for the rights of a local property owner. Harriet and the landowner were eventually successful in beating back the federal government’s efforts to take control of our irrigation infrastructure.

clean_body: | | | | Friends, Welcome back to the “Weekly Wyoming Wrap-Up.” Harriet continues traveling the state to visit with her fellow Wyomingites about the issues that we are facing. All of us in Wyoming are concerned about the chaos in Washington, the failing democrat agenda, and the way these failures impact our daily lives. Stay tuned for exciting announcements about upcoming events across Wyoming! For Wyoming, Team Hageman Around Wyoming Harriet traveled to Worland for the Agar bull sale, stopping by Maggie’s Café for an early breakfast. Harriet is remarkably familiar with the Worland area, having spent seven years in a legal battle against the EPA and Army Corps of Engineers fighting for the rights of a local property owner. Harriet and the landowner were eventually successful in beating back the federal government’s efforts to take control of our irrigation infrastructure. In The News As race continues to heat up, we continue to gain national attention. Harriet was on four national broadcasts this week including the ! | | | |

As expected, national Democrats are coming in to defend Elissa Slotkin’s hold on the new 7th District. This week, they launched a billboard campaign taking aim at my vote against corporate welfare.

---|---|---
My vote against corporate welfare was not a vote against General Motors, it’s that I prefer to invest in our roads and infrastructure, and reform our tax and regulatory framework, which is what makes Michigan uncompetitive.Elissa Slotkin prefers bribing corporations with tax dollars from small businesses, who took the brunt of the pandemic, and the working and middle class struggling to get by with record inflation. body:

[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zb55d2sv3avnstefook33inihjqsd6k45g1d2fug_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk1p7fcdkmcqjas3h6gonact66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2ukrm6tj7mlqb2dhn6arjfcdjcpj6aclhcep35d72cmqbecdi6upm6ohimdpjbc77q9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphlcsqr9ptim9j3coljcorr1db5e8gq48bi4bh28or1c5ie4oj0spj649fg)
This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z5tquvdimllrmuh1n72uf35kr6n8l7016oei8tfo_rp22sh2s8i66ob1cjh64o76cph2bs)
---
| |
Dear Friend, While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don’t know his full story—especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons.

King David’s momentous story provides profound insights into many of life’s most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others?

Taught by Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, **“The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King”** examines the Old Testament books of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores David’s character and the consequences of his choices on his family and the people of Israel.
---
| | **This is why we’ve produced our online course, “The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King,” which is now available on DVD. And you can reserve your copy using this secure link:**

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/david-story-dvd](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zdddv771si4k4qg734c91kpkilv7mqoss00j309o_rp22sh2s8i66ob1cjh64o76cph2bs)** By viewing the course, you’ll learn more about the nature of God, family, leadership, sin, and repentance; in short, you’ll learn more about what truly matters in life. **I hope you’ll reserve your DVD today and share its abiding lessons with your family and friends. The DVD is perfect for a Bible study or homeschool curriculum.**
---
| [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z27ahstfovr95c20f43q9efs56mh7vi3fs19upjg_rp22sh2s8i66ob1cjh64o76cph2bs)
---
| | Let’s learn what truly matters in life by studying **“The David Story.”**

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

# Inflation + A Stock Market Correction Is A Disaster For Your Retirement
---
| Friend,

If you have money in the stock market I can imagine these past few weeks have been stressful.

We've seen huge dips, massive rebounds, just for the market to dip again. While there are always ebbs and flows in the stock market, this kind of volatility is dangerous.

The stock market was already inflated and due for a correction, but here's what we know about what's happening now:

1\. Institutional investors have lost confidence in the Biden administration's ability to manage the economy.

2\. This loss of confidence is causing them to sell off and bank the record profits that were gained under President Trump.

3\. This wide scale sell-off has increased volatility and indicates a massive correction could be coming soon.

When you combine the precarious position the stock market is in with the fact that we are seeing record breaking inflation, supply chain issues, and global instability, it's time for you to be pro-active and look to protect your wealth.

Gold and precious metals can help you diversify your portfolio and protect you from a stock market collapse and rising inflation. [Legacy Precious Metals](http://click1.srnemail.com/vjkyhgqqhckncczqnkktfnmcdhnjgddcvgtzdvkvyjhfvr_wddsswwvwlvjbdswwjvffff.html) is the company I trust for investing in gold and silver.

Here's how gold can help you:
* Gold has historically been inversely proportional to the dollar, so when the dollar goes down, gold goes up.
* Gold provides a hedge against inflation and a weakening dollar.
* Gold has flexibility. You can store gold in your home, or roll your existing retirement account into a Gold IRA and keep all the tax advantages.

Legacy Precious Metals has a team of IRA experts who can give you personalized advice based on your financial situation. Call my friends at [Legacy Precious Metals](http://click1.srnemail.com/pcjvmlrrmgybggkrbyyshbdgwmbclwwgqlskwqyqvcmhqh_wddsswwvwlvjbdswwjvffff.html) today at (866) 649-0337.

Dear Friend, While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don’t know his full story—especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons.

King David’s momentous story provides profound insights into many of life’s most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others?

Taught by Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, **“The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King”** examines the Old Testament books of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores David’s character and the consequences of his choices on his family and the people of Israel.
---

He never won a “Mr. Congeniality” contest, but when the going got tough, you wanted Grandpa Earl around. In the 1940s, Grandpa Earl was the Sheriff of Mitchell County, Kansas. Population today: less than 6,500.

Us grandkids learned a lot from Grandpa Earl. He was regarded as a great sheriff because he knew who he was and never tried to be something else—and he knew who the people of Mitchell County were and what they expected—and he respected that.

We learned to always stay true to ourselves and move on down the road. Never give up. Never stop fighting.

We are in a battle right now for the future of our country. It might be easy to get discouraged watching the radical Left try to move our country in entirely the wrong direction. _But we can’t back down or give in. We have to stay in the fight and stand up for what is right._

I’m going to continue traveling all across the country to support conservatives as we push to win back the House, the Senate, Governorships and races up and down the ballot.

I need your help if we are going to be successful. As a top grassroots leader, I’m hoping you will make a donation of $100, $50 or $25 to help us push back against the radical Left and champion American values. **[Chip in to become a member of the Conservative Cavalry before it’s too late>>](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-3i1t9-1ycqk-4qqlpo2/ "Chip in to become a member of the Conservative Cavalry before it’s too late >>>")** I promise you that I will never stop fighting for our values, our freedoms, and our country. _Because Grandpa Earl taught me to keep my faith, to work hard and to never give an inch._

Fighting for our future,

I’ll be blunt: If I don’t catch up to him and catch up quick, he’s going to blow me out of the water come November and threaten to turn Louisiana and the U.S. Senate into a Socialist safe haven. name: Freedom First Project
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.-bCnhkvLpw8-EjgU5w) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives-but supported by many well-meaning Americans-to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue-views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics-too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention-and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. ArnnPresident, Hillsdale CollegePursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

name: Victoria Virasingh
subject: Honoring Black History Month
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Victoria for Congress
body:
[https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vv-mnc-email?refcode=220105_FR_newyearnewemail_LOGO [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vv-mnc-email?refcode=220105_FR_newyearnewemail_LOGO] [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
We are halfway through Black History Month, and I wanted to take this moment to celebrate and reflect on Black achievements throughout American History.
Everyday we see the Black community’s contribution to this country’s economic, cultural, and political values. It is important that we reflect during Black History Month as well as uplift Black leaders, activists, writers, poets, business owners, and the wider Black community. These efforts must not be limited to this month, but carried on throughout the year.
As we witness modern attacks on history in our textbooks, it is a reminder we must recognize our past to move forward in our future. As a representative for Virginia’s 8th, I will fight to continue uplifting the history of our country.
I will continue fighting for voting rights, an end to the racial wealth gap, and policies that will rectify the inequalities in our community and wider country. This month we honor a legacy of achievement and excellence in the Black community, but in March, I will get to work making the changes necessary to empower Black business owners, students, and leaders.

Victoria Virasingh is the daughter of immigrants. She grew up housing insecure and watched her working parents struggle to pull their family out of poverty. But today, even those opportunities to work hard and live the American dream are becoming less and less attainable.
That's why Victoria is running for Congress in Virginia's 8th District -- to create equitable opportunities for those who have been left behind, to expand access for the store owner to the refugee, to support our struggling elders and students, and to lift up working families.

body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59559122:6tk2jZEN4:m:1:3253819041:A05DBE349E6706C31B7AD63B65BA6C60:r) Tucker Carlson said it himself: if you're thinking of writing a check...think of writing it to Ryan Girdusky. I'll tell you why. I've seen what's happening in our schools -- on our dimes, and I'm sure you have too. All over the country, teachers are brainwashing children to hate themselves and hate their country. They tell students that if they're white they're evil racists responsible for slavery, and if they're black they're helpless victims that will never accomplish anything. _It 's state sanctioned racism, plain and simple._ **And it doesn 't matter how old you are, or how long your own children have been out of school -- we all have a leg in this race.** ** ** **[Which is why I 'm asking you to make an urgent donation of $35 or more today to help us fight the spread of Critical Race Theory and elect conservatives who care about the truth.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59559122:6tk2jZEN4:m:1:3253819041:A05DBE349E6706C31B7AD63B65BA6C60:r)** Because if the radical Left succeeds in brainwashing an entire generation, America won't survive. _The generation taught to hate our country from kindergarten to college will be the one that destroys it._ They will beg our leaders to strip us of our rights and freedoms until we have none left. They will run our country into the ground and create chaos and despair where we once had prosperity and excellence. **They will surrender our country to Marxism, and we may never get it back.** The sacrifices of our forefathers will have been for nothing, our wars will have been fought for nothing, and our proud history will be reduced to nothing. **[But there 's something you can do.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59559122:6tk2jZEN4:m:1:3253819041:A05DBE349E6706C31B7AD63B65BA6C60:r)** That's why I'm writing to you today. Because our fate isn't sealed -- yet.__But we must act now.__ My name is Ryan Girdusky and I've made it my mission to make education sane again. I created the 1776 Project Political Action Committee to do what our politicians won't and take back our schools. **I 'm going state to state and county to county targeting school board elections, campaigning and fundraising for candidates that will take a strong stance against Critical Race Theory and the 1619 Project.** But I don't stand a chance without you. **[Please donate $35 or more to the 1776 Project PAC and save our schools from race-baiting, America-hating Marxists.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59559122:6tk2jZEN4:m:1:3253819041:A05DBE349E6706C31B7AD63B65BA6C60:r)** And make no mistake -- this isn't just a California or New York problem. **Critical Race Theory is already being taught in EVERY SINGLE state.** It's happening from coast to coast, in red, blue and purple states alike. And if we don't take action, we'll all pay the price. You and I have to take a stand NOW. Thank you in advance for your support. Sincerely, Ryan J. subject: Let’s take back our communities

body:
Dear Peter,

For too long, people like me and you have been left out.

Developers, landlords, and big banks have gentrified our neighborhoods and evicted us from our homes. Private insurance companies have put a price tag on our health and well-being. And we’ve been targeted by a justice system that doesn’t value our lives.

Our representatives are supposed to fight for us, but instead, they’ve only fought for power and influence over our communities.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e-2022welcome [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e-2022welcome]I’ve spent my career organizing inside and outside the halls of power — and I’ve learned that New Jersey’s elected officials serve party bosses and special interests, not us. Case in point: my opponent has taken thousands of dollars from corporate PACs run by Exxon Mobil, pharmaceutical giant Merck, and the American Association of Oil Pipelines.

It doesn’t have to be this way. We can elect real progressive leaders who will fight for housing justice, Medicare for All, and a Green New Deal.

That’s why I’m running for Congress in New Jersey’s 10th District: to defeat New Jersey’s corrupt machine and be a progressive champion for our communities. If you’re with me, click here to watch and share our video and make a contribution today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e-augustwelcome]

I know what it’s like to be left out. My family was left out when we almost lost our home during the 2008 financial crisis. I was left out when my insurance faltered and I couldn’t afford life-saving medication.

I’ve spent my entire career fighting to dismantle New Jersey’s political machine, standing up against the corporate establishment, and protecting members of our community who have been left behind. Now, I’m running for Congress to continue that fight.

I’m proud to have the support of national progressive organizations like Brand New Congress. But your support matters most, Peter. So today, I’m asking you to stand up and fight with me. Chip in now to help us build this grassroots movement — and together, let’s take back our communities. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e-2022welcome]

Thank you for being on my team.

— Imani Oakley

body:
| | |
---
I've got good news and bad news, friend.

**Let me start with the good news:** While my rich Republican opponents fight it out in a messy primary and prop up their campaigns with millions of their own dollars, we've got grassroots momentum behind us – with thousands of folks like you chipping in $5, $25 or $100 at a time.
**Now here's the problem:** With time running out before tonight's crucial mid-month deadline at midnight, we're way behind our $25,000 goal. Missing it would be a huge setback while national Republicans pour upward of _$40 million_ into Ohio to buy this Senate seat.
These megadonors don't give a damn about working families. They just care about electing someone who will keep lining their pockets. That's exactly why I'm in this fight to flip Ohio blue, expand our majority and finally pass some legislation that helps working families.
**But I can't do it alone, and the stakes couldn't be higher: Experts at NBC News say that ****our battleground race could decide Senate control. Early voting is now underway in the race for Congressional District 30! I will address those issues and the issues important to the voters of senate district 11, such as; property taxes, hurricane preparedness, homelessness, infrastructure and flood mitigation. name: Harmeet
subject: What Laura Ingraham said, Peter
body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59564829:Jj-gTZENL:m:1:3298722022:1700935F5F1AA08D8C822786528EA25A:r) Dear Peter, Radical activist teachers brainwashed a 12-year-old girl to think she's a "boy" and hid it from her mother... So, we're dragging the teachers and school into court to make them pay for their disgusting actions and stop this from happening to other children. [**But to win this critical case I need your help today. That is why I'm asking you to join me by donating to make sure these radical teachers can't brainwash any more children.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59564829:Jj-gTZENL:m:1:3298722022:1700935F5F1AA08D8C822786528EA25A:r) In case you missed the details of our case when I announced it with Laura Ingraham on her great **Fox News** show **The Ingraham Angle** let me recap it for you. One day Jessica Konen, a mother of a young 12-year-old girl in middle school was called in and told by the school that her daughter was now a "boy." What she found out was that over the past several months teachers indoctrinated her sixth-grade daughter into believing she was transgender and bisexual. Her daughter didn't even know what those two words meant until these sick activist teachers infected her daughter with their twisted beliefs... The teachers recruited Jessica's daughter to join their "Equality Club" where she was told she may be transgender and bisexual. The teachers then helped her to create a totally new identity with new names, new pronouns and had her use a different bathroom. They even created a "Gender Support Plan" for her and instructed the faculty to use her new male name and pronouns -- ALL without her mother's knowledge. And worse than that -- **these radical teachers told Jessica's daughter NOT to tell her mom because she couldn't be "trusted**." The actions of these teachers and the school are sickening... They intentionally hid their radical indoctrination from Jessica -- even though the Supreme Court has consistently ruled that parents have the right to control their children's education. Left-wing activist teachers, administrators and schools are out-of-control... It's disgusting. It's awful. And we have to stop them. That's why I'm asking for your help today. [**Will you join me to make these Left-wing activist teachers and the school pay for their illegal actions?** ](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59564829:Jj-gTZENL:m:1:3298722022:1700935F5F1AA08D8C822786528EA25A:r) You see, we are suing the school AND the teachers for their illegal actions... Because the only way we're going to stop these activist teachers and administrators is to drag them into court. The fact is that we have no idea how many other children this is happening to across the country -- Jessica's daughter is just one example. We know the California Department of Education and the teachers' associations train schools and teachers to keep secrets from parents... Who knows how many other young children are being poisoned? Left-wing radicals are using our classrooms to brainwash our children and grandchildren with their sick-and-twisted views. And we have an opportunity to stop it. This lawsuit puts every single activist teacher, administrator and school on notice -- if you mess with our children, **we will see you in court**! They should be teaching our children math, reading and history -- not pushing them to become transgender or bisexual. But, to stop this from happening -- we need to win this case... That's why I'm asking for your help immediately today. [_**Will you please step up and make a generous donation to help us drag these radical activists to court?** _](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59564829:Jj-gTZENL:m:1:3298722022:1700935F5F1AA08D8C822786528EA25A:r) And please know here at the Center for American Liberty we don't just file lawsuits -- we **WIN****** them!! My name is Harmeet Dhillon and you may recognize me from my numerous appearances on **Newsmax** and **Fox News** with **Laura Ingraham, Tucker Carlson, Shannon Bream** and **Fox and Friends**. I've been on a lot talking about our numerous legal battles _and victories_ against the radical Left. We've already won three major victories for religious liberty before the U.S. Supreme Court. We're also taking the fight to big tech and the politicians who are conspiring to silence and destroy conservatives... But this case to stop activist teachers from corrupting and hurting our children and grandchildren is so important -- it's one we cannot afford to lose. [**That's why, I'm asking if you can give today -- $35, $50, $100, $250 or more. I will use it to protect our children and grandchildren from the radical Left.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59564829:Jj-gTZENL:m:1:3298722022:1700935F5F1AA08D8C822786528EA25A:r) So, the next time a radical teacher wants to poison another child with their sick beliefs they'll know that we're watching and are ready to drag them into court... That is the only way we're going to stop them -- they have to fear the consequences of their actions! With your help, we'll hold these teachers accountable for brainwashing and grooming their young students- and we'll put all radical leftist teachers on notice that they won't get away with their plot to indoctrinate our kids and erase our parental rights. Thank you in advance for your support. **God Bless,** **Harmeet K. Dhillon** **Founder & CEO,** **The Center for American Liberty** [**DONATE**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59564829:Jj-gTZENL:m:1:3298722022:1700935F5F1AA08D8C822786528EA25A:r) P.S. Radical activist teachers in California tricked a 12-year-old girl into believing she was transgender and bisexual. They helped her change into a "boy" with a new identity a new name and new pronouns -- **and told her to hide it from her mother.** Now we're dragging these activist teachers and the school into court to pay for their abuse of her young daughter, and I need your help to win. [That's why I'm asking you to give an emergency tax-deductible donation of $20, $35, $50, $100, $250 to stop these radical liberals from poisoning our children. ](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59564829:Jj-gTZENL:m:1:3298722022:1700935F5F1AA08D8C822786528EA25A:r) We must win this case and put every single Left-wing teacher and school on notice -- if you infect our children with your radical values we will drag you into court too! [**DONATE**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59564829:Jj-gTZENL:m:1:3298722022:1700935F5F1AA08D8C822786528EA25A:r) [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59564829:Jj-gTZENL:m:1:3298722022:1700935F5F1AA08D8C822786528EA25A:r) [**Please consider supporting our efforts to defend our Constitution with a donation today.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/59564829:Jj-gTZENL:m:1:3298722022:1700935F5F1AA08D8C822786528EA25A:r) The Center For American Liberty is a 501(c)(3) charitable organization created to fight against growing anti-free-speech and anti-civil liberties trends.

subject: We must engage them aggressively
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vs2gqaaHCN

Anti-Americanism has long been evident in higher education. But
recently, it has spread from college campuses to other areas of
American life.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/os2gqaaHCN

Dear
fellow American,

Anti-Americanism has long been evident in higher education. But
recently, it has spread from college campuses to other areas of
American life.

Today it
asserts itself in many forms-including critical race theory-in
our government, in our K-12 schools, in our corporations, in the
media, in sports, and even in our military.

The
recent election in Virginia brought the corruption of American
K-12 education, in particular, to the forefront of our national
conversation.

The
breakdown (especially among younger Americans) of informed
patriotism-without which self-government is impossible-is not
something we can allow to continue.

While
there is reason to remain hopeful, there is much work to be done
to reverse the current trends in the months and years ahead.

Education
is where this attack on America began-and it is the battlefield
on which we must engage the Left in defense of liberty and
limited constitutional government.

Hillsdale
College has been deeply engaged in this battle for decades. We
are now determined, with the help of supporters like you, who
agree with Hillsdale's mission, to redouble our efforts at this
crucial time for our nation-no matter the cost.

That's
why we are expanding our Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by
Reaching and Teaching Millions in 2022.

You can
support this vital project through this link:
https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/preserve-freedom-for-future-generations

The
Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching
Millions will give informed patriots across the country the
effective ability to defend liberty through education. And we
need your help.

The
project has three key objectives:

Expand the circulation of Imprimis, our digest of liberty, to
reach millions more Americans.

Increase the number of citizens (especially younger Americans)
enrolling in our free online courses, such as "Constitution 101:
The Meaning and History of the Constitution," "The Great American
Story: A Land of Hope," and our newest course, "American
Citizenship and Its Decline" with Victor Davis Hanson.

Launch additional Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 charter
schools nationwide and provide, free of charge, our American
classical K-12 curriculum (including the new Hillsdale 1776
Curriculum) to thousands more American teachers and
homeschoolers.

And your
generous support is critical to our success. Here's why...

Hillsdale
College conducts its educational outreach efforts on behalf of
liberty-as it does all of its work-while refusing to accept one
penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of
federal or state student grants or loans.

So, to
expand this effective program, we will need thousands of gifts
between $25 and $100. This is the range in which most supporters
give. We will also need a significant number of $500 to $1,000
donations. But contributions of any size are appreciated.

We
urgently need your help.

You can
safely and securely renew your support using this link:

https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/preserve-freedom-for-future-generations

As the
forces of anti-Americanism redouble their own efforts to
undermine informed patriotism in our schools and our culture, and
to subvert constitutionalism in our government, we must engage
them ever more aggressively-including on the central battlefield
of education.

That's
why I hope you'll make your most generous gift in this critical
year for America.

Every
dollar you can give will help expand our Project to Defend
Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions in 2022.

Thank you
for your generosity. I hope you'll stand with us. Together, we
will work to preserve freedom for future generations of
Americans.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:
Fellow Patriot:

The long-simmering cold war between conservatives and Big Tech is boiling over into open conflict, and we're ready.
This fight has been a long time coming. Massive tech corporations have been targeting conservatives for years - censoring, silencing, and canceling anyone who dissents from their woke fanaticism.
They manipulated 2020 elections. They covered up the Hunter Biden scandal. They hid the truth about the origins of Covid-19 and Anthony Fauci's politicized science. They are a multi-trillion-dollar arm of the Elite Left abusing the American people and threatening the
fundamental fairness of our republic.
Thankfully, Senate conservatives are fighting back.
▶︎ Sen. Josh Hawley (R-MO) has been waging this fight for years now. He has introduced legislation to end Big Tech monopolist tactics.
▶︎ Sen. Mike Lee (R-UT) has written legislation to split Big Tech's advertising businesses off from their parent corporations.
▶︎ Sen. Cynthia Lummis (R-WY) has a bill to ban Big Tech companies from giving preferential treatment to their own products.
▶︎ Sen. Ted Cruz (R-TX) has put the stakes bluntly, saying "Big Tech censorship is the biggest threat to free speech in America."
CONSERVATIVES ARE THE ONLY PEOPLE IN WASHINGTON WALKING THE WALK AGAINST BIG TECH: THEY NEED ALL THE HELP WE CAN GIVE THEM!
SCF supports these conservative leaders for having the guts to stand up for the country and the Constitution. But now the Silicon Valley Empire is Striking Back!
Big Tech is reportedly creating a new political action committee dedicated to electing "moderates" to the U.S. Senate.
We both know what they mean: woke, big government socialists... who will let tech billionaires do whatever they want. That's not "moderate" - it's just more latte-liberal self-interest masquerading as "social justice."
These Tech Oligarchs literally want to buy Senate seats for corporate-friendly Republicans and Democrats. Their strategy is going to be to take out conservative Senators and candidates in Republican primaries - and they have billionaires bankrolling them.
ALL WE HAVE IS YOU!
Big Tech is trying to intimidate conservatives into backing down and playing ball. Every principled, fighting conservative who can't be bought? They will work to destroy.
We need to support them. Today.
HELP SENATE CONSERVATIVES FIGHT BIG TECH!
In this fight, the stakes could not be higher:
▶︎ Free speech▶︎ Media integrity▶︎ Election integrity▶︎ Economic freedom▶︎ Corporate surveillance▶︎ Corporate cooperation with China
Big Tech is really Bad Tech. Conservatives taking them on have targets on their backs. Senate Conservatives Fund stands ready to help, but we can't do it alone.
America needs your help to rescue our country from these election-rigging digital overlords once and for all.
Please contribute to SCF today!
Thank you for considering this urgent request and for doing so much to help fight for America's future.

Sincerely,

Mary Vought
Executive Director
Senate Conservatives Fund

 

 

END OF THE MONTH
COUNTDOWN

Wow, folks...early voting started yesterday, and it’s honestly quite surreal. Am I dreaming?

Every time someone has already said to me, “ _I voted for you!_ ” I need Kavin (my campaign manager) to pinch me. I truly cannot believe how far we’ve come and that this moment is already here — people casting their ballots _for me. _I'm beyond humbled.

When I entered this race, I knew it was going to be a tough fight. I’m a low-income, working-class, Black woman without some major rolodex of mega-donors, plus I’m rejecting all corporate PAC money.

We knew that in order to win this race and create an effective, viable campaign the RIGHT way — _the people-first way_ — it was going to take a lot of groundwork to build a solid grassroots coalition that would carry our movement.

Now, here we are, a year later with endorsements from veterans groups like Vote Vets and groundbreakers in the progressive movement like Nina Turner and Brand New Congress — _**and**_ an outstanding alliance of everyday working folks across the country who are ready for a New Deal.

You’ve stuck with me every step of the way and none of this would be possible without your unwavering support. You’ve trusted me, and you haven’t given up hope of a brighter future. And I can’t tell you how much that continues to inspire me every single day.

**Everything we’ve worked so hard for has culminated to this moment.** The moment where Texans are making their very real final decisions on who to vote for. The finish line is within reach, and we’ve got to make the most of every resource and every second that remains. _There is still time left — but not much of it._

**_The primary election is just TWO WEEKS away,_** and we’re maximizing all strategies to ensure no voter is left behind — by holding events, canvassing, knocking on doors, making phone calls, blasting out digital content, and using every last ounce of energy to GOTV and boost turnout.

**Tonight is our FINAL mid-month goal deadline, and if we’re even a single penny behind, it’s going to slow us down — which we absolutely cannot afford at this crucial time.**

body:
I've been saying it for over a year now.
---
| | | | | |
---
| VIDEO: President Trump Has Always Been Right--Hillary Spied, The Media Lied
"Hillary Clinton not only tried to infiltrate servers on President Trump's campaign, but her associates abused and exploited their government access to spy on White House data records. This proves the left is evil and will do whatever it takes in order to rig an election and frame a sitting president." - Eric Greitens
---
| St. Louis, MO - In shocking new court filings by Special Counsel John Durham, associates for the Hillary Clinton 2016 campaign used a technology firm to infiltrate computer servers from Donald J. Trump's campaign at Trump Tower. Even more deplorable is that this same operation extended to the White House after President Trump was sworn in. The filing notes the technology company linked to Clinton abused their existing government cybersecurity contracts in order to access private government data as part of their Russia hoax. According to Durham's office: "Tech Executive-1 and his associates exploited this arrangement by mining the EOP's DNS traffic and other data for the purpose of gathering derogatory information about Donald Trump." Clinton campaign advisor Jake Sullivan--Biden's current National Security Advisor-- also peddled falsehoods about Russia collusion through press releases, media interviews, and various other propaganda efforts. Governor Eric Greitens has continued to raise the issue of Clinton spying on President Trump's campaign, [dating back to January 2021](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001IsfcZ6NdibnEOSD4wBpu_x5ididI96Jf-uhwGl0z05R8GN7H9H8vuabP3Z20p_9Io2RAEvNxTrSLlCN9B7kI1t6wD53e3YsF6q4DZWTYZIayWvQUSH5rME4rD7bTkQNA9g3ywBrKviR_YFTAcSFawrs_BoEjzQI89UUIbd7UP-FcPYsLhVwhtQ==&c=lFMw88CJyblBt2XLd9QBaCqE8d5fHbQ8-N37Ko9tcNqz2oK_oFSszA==&ch=i79geuvX0v9mopkWrAxjgMYmFojje3CUd_LNqzc8gJfe54G3-hrCOg==). **Hageman releases initial statewide team of Wyoming grassroots leaders**
---
Harriet Hageman, Republican candidate for Wyoming’s lone seat in the U.S. House of Representatives, has released an impressive first list of grassroots leaders who will drive her campaign efforts across the state. These volunteers will focus on Hageman’s history of fighting for and defending Wyoming and Wyoming’s values, while spreading her message regarding how she will carry those principles to Congress. This show of grassroots and organizational strength demonstrates a broad and deep well of support among people who will vote in Wyoming’s August 16 Republican primary. Hageman will continue to add to this list as she builds out her campaign across the state. “Growing up on my family’s ranch outside Fort Laramie, I learned the ‘Code of the West’ and the value of hard work and loyalty,” Hageman said. “I am as Wyoming as you can get, and I am proud to have put together a grassroots team of outstanding Wyomingites who love our state just as much as I do. I am grateful for their support, and I know that with their help, we will win this election and have a congresswoman who actually represents Wyoming’s interests.” Hageman is challenging incumbent Rep. Liz Cheney, who has abandoned the people of Wyoming by spending her time as Nancy Pelosi’s hand-picked “Republican” on the sham January 6th Committee attacking President Trump. clean_body: | | | | Hageman releases initial statewide team of Wyoming grassroots leaders Harriet Hageman, Republican candidate for Wyoming’s lone seat in the U.S. House of Representatives, has released an impressive first list of grassroots leaders who will drive her campaign efforts across the state. These volunteers will focus on Hageman’s history of fighting for and defending Wyoming and Wyoming’s values, while spreading her message regarding how she will carry those principles to Congress. This show of grassroots and organizational strength demonstrates a broad and deep well of support among people who will vote in Wyoming’s August 16 Republican primary. Hageman will continue to add to this list as she builds out her campaign across the state. “Growing up on my family’s ranch outside Fort Laramie, I learned the ‘Code of the West’ and the value of hard work and loyalty,” Hageman said. “I am as Wyoming as you can get, and I am proud to have put together a grassroots team of outstanding Wyomingites who love our state just as much as I do. I am grateful for their support, and I know that with their help, we will win this election and have a congresswoman who actually represents Wyoming’s interests.” Hageman is challenging incumbent Rep. Liz Cheney, who has abandoned the people of Wyoming by spending her time as Nancy Pelosi’s hand-picked “Republican” on the sham January 6th Committee attacking President Trump. As reported by the , Cheney rarely visits Wyoming and has now decided that referring to state Republicans as “crazies” is the road to victory. Hageman, a constitutional attorney who specializes in protecting water rights, property rights, and civil rights, has built her career fighting federal government overreach. Hageman has been endorsed by former President Donald Trump and Senator Rand Paul. She beat Cheney in a state central committee straw poll last month by a lopsided margin. She has visited all 23 counties in Wyoming, traveling over 13,000 miles since announcing her candidacy in September 2021. subject: Is Election Fraud Happening Again?
body:
| Peter -- **Establishment RINOs are Terrified of our campaign!** So terrified, some are already committing election fraud. In the past two weeks since caucus night, there has been growing concern about some of the data Republican Party officials are using to determine who will go to the State Convention to endorse a candidate for governor. It is disheartening to think that some in our very own party would try to manipulate the system and break the rules to pad their chances of winning the GOP Endorsement. **But we cannot stay silent!** Our campaign stands firmly in support of election integrity and total transparency. We will not back down from calling out establishment insiders and RINOs who want to cut your voice out of the endorsement process! Unfortunately, we do have evidence that some fraud was carried out. In a press release issued last night, I am calling for a full forensic audit of caucus data, and a hold on all local party conventions until the original delegate signup sheets from caucus night are disclosed to campaigns and verified by an independent third party. [Other candidates for statewide office have also called for these election security measures.](https://electneil.nationbuilder.com/r?u=YqgukYA3Mrlri-dqG7I8TvxVeHDpHtFbpZbKd0jDY3pi_GTuJWiiylX6X-pNVhB06FQvq6VJiSst5mcrkwoDnnUXEOcIT54Ob9-ch3L8oPciQKcSf3uGngOzd60-iLpf&e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=caucus_data&n=1) _How big is the problem? How much of the data errors can be attributed to fraud? How much was a series of genuine mistakes?_ To put it plainly - We don’t know. But we need to find out. **If you signed up to be a delegate on caucus night, fill out this survey to ensure your voice will be heard, and to aid in our investigation.** | [](https://electneil.nationbuilder.com/r?u=FHnL8ikUv8WviObJjkW8kTR7ozFiVSYhzSu-2EwIkQCGLrzZd4Q97N6hSNgmqVmJrU-6kHW_dO3hLTYP_FSPX6QEm4_x55V-VaSwT4JqNKnwsu4JN6bt1wd2wCX8HRbVPyvN6BjavkK08YGB89GCGA&e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=caucus_data&n=2 "Caucus Integrity Survey") [Caucus Integrity Survey](https://electneil.nationbuilder.com/r?u=FHnL8ikUv8WviObJjkW8kTR7ozFiVSYhzSu-2EwIkQCGLrzZd4Q97N6hSNgmqVmJrU-6kHW_dO3hLTYP_FSPX6QEm4_x55V-VaSwT4JqNKnwsu4JN6bt1wd2wCX8HRbVPyvN6BjavkK08YGB89GCGA&e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=caucus_data&n=2)
---
At best, this situation is primarily the result of honest mistakes. At the very worst, it is a concerted attempt to keep the outsider constitutional conservative from disrupting career politicians.
We need your help to get to the bottom of this!
Fill out our caucus integrity survey and [**Donate Today** to support the outsider grassroots candidate.](https://electneil.nationbuilder.com/r?u=iUaD1gacZHU3dYzSqkV0rDwg01bMOn9gGWui5cl2dLg&e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=caucus_data&n=3)
As the political outsider we are facing an uphill battle. With your support we can keep spreading our message of health freedom, election integrity, and a constitutionally limited government.
Republicans are in desperate need of an outsider candidate who will **reinvigorate our party and transform it into a powerful force that Tim Walz Fears. **
We are not taking money from lobbyists, insiders, or special interests. [Please support our campaign to Save Minnesota with $25, $50, $100, or more today.](https://electneil.nationbuilder.com/r?u=iUaD1gacZHU3dYzSqkV0rDwg01bMOn9gGWui5cl2dLg&e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=caucus_data&n=4)
**Thank You,**
Dr. Neil Shah
Conservative Candidate for Governor

body:
The Parkland shooting changed my high school experience forever.

| Four years ago yesterday, 17 of my fellow students’, classmates', and teachers’ lives were taken abruptly in a mass shooting at my high school, Marjory Stoneman Douglas. What should have been a fairly normal week at school turned into the scariest time of my life.

The Parkland shooting changed my high school experience forever. From there on out, armed security officers were all around campus and school therapists were readily available.

This shouldn’t be the “normal” high school experience, but because of our nation’s lack of common sense gun safety legislation, **it has become the norm.**

I don’t want to live in a country where mass shootings happen nearly every day. No one should have to go through what my high school community has experienced.

Dr. Annie Andrews knows that simple solutions like implementing stronger background checks could save so many lives, and make our schools, synagogues, churches, movie theaters, and communities safer.

[Join me and Dr. Annie today to demand action to prevent future gun violence tragedies.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41829019/330515854/-1471307163?refcode=AA_EM_PT_3MO_220215_1_2&refcode2=&contactdata=Cxzm7sejsvq1Vlo8GnEis9fLLw3muqPSxAwdWlrd4HxfLHw1HEmQ5PwxVvziU8ev&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NGJhMDE4OC04ZjhlLWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sLynuOCMsAivaXw0OX9xCoYK6MwszNMiHWCgTktxFxo=&emci=71ba0188-8f8e-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=74ba0188-8f8e-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=6125529)

name: Tobias Read
subject: A real plan for our kids
body:
This week I began rolling out my policy platform, sharing my vision for the future of Oregon.
---
| | Dear Peter, School staff, teachers, and students are struggling here in Oregon. We can all see it, and time and again we’ve heard candidates and leaders beat around the bush instead of tackling the problems head on. **Our schools need, and deserve, bold change that will make a real, measurable difference for our students.** **[This week I began rolling out my policy platform, sharing my vision for the future of Oregon.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41829146/330516542/-1172831623?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOWJiZTU5Mi05MDhlLWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=g85JqqFlGYc0KMCnUDcWtXFn7pDLu6b1EBaoV9b8K_k=&emci=c4ce038c-908e-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=c9bbe592-908e-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=30662126)** I started with my K-12 education platform because, to me, education is simultaneously the most essential public service and the most pressing challenge we’re facing. If Oregonians elect me Governor, we will transform our schools into true hubs for learning, healthcare, and other essential services. Broadly, my plan calls for reducing out-of-pocket costs to students and families, expanding options for programs and learning throughout the year and into the summer, prioritizing mental and physical health, challenging students with rigorous learning opportunities, and investing heavily in our education workforce. Perhaps most importantly, I will increase academic support and training for those who teach our youngest learners, and reduce our emphasis on redundant and ineffective standardized testing. **It’s time we get serious about closing the literacy gap.** Learning happens when teachers and students have the time and resources they need. It’s also time we get serious about giving all Oregon kids a chance to succeed, to reach their dreams in college or to find an apprenticeship that will lead to a family wage job. We will propose transforming the Common School Fund into an Education Endowment that will issue “baby bonds” to every child born in Oregon with a $1,000 529 college savings account. This will signal to future generations of Oregon school children that we believe in them, and are willing to support their dreams. But we also need to stabilize our educator workforces and support the hardworking people who have sacrificed so much for our kids. My plan calls for providing school districts with funding to offer hazard pay, student loan forgiveness for teachers who commit to teaching for 5 years, and diversifying our workforce by creating a pathway for interested students of diverse backgrounds to become hometown teachers. **We can’t afford any half measures.** Oregon is in desperate need of leadership that will transform how we educate our children. As your Governor, I won’t wait to get it done. Stay safe,

---

subject: Peter – She Is Buying Votes Again
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Michael Brown for Governor • P
body:
Governor Whitmer is on a spending spree because revenues happen to be up. I believe Michigan citizens see it for what it is – buying votes. | | | |
---
| | |
---
|
---
| Peter:

Have you seen the latest from Governor Whitmer?

Once again she’s picking winners and losers as _she doles out hundreds of thousands of dollars_.

It’s such a transparent attempt to buy votes, but she’s so tone deaf that _she’s only giving money to her chosen classes of Michiganders_.

So, if you were “on the front lines” during the pandemic you get a check!

But if you were one of the hundreds of thousands of hard-working residents who lost their jobs because of her ill-conceived shutdown, do you get a check? Nope.

Or perhaps you are a business owner who struggled to keep your business afloat, or maybe tragically, your business went under. Do you get help? Nope.

Maybe you’re a parent who suddenly had to take on the added burden of helping your children through “distance learning” while trying to hold onto your own job. Do you get help? Nope.

**This is the problem with a government that picks winners. And make no mistake, that’s what Whitmer and her cronies are doing.**

Just like during 2020 when Whitmer labeled some jobs “essential” while relegating others to the scrap heap.

**This is just wrong.**

Governor Whitmer has just released her budget proposal. It is a crazy spending spree that’s more than 10% higher than last year. Did your income increase 10% last year?

Peter, I’ve got a plan that will help all of our citizens. It does not rely on giving one time payments to certain classes of people.

It starts with reducing our state income tax rate to 3.25%.

Fourteen states have cut their tax rates in the past two years. Tax rates in neighboring Ohio are now lower than our rates in Michigan. Indiana is working to further cut income taxes and business taxes.

By cutting Michigan’s income tax, we will not only stimulate our own economy, but we will once again become competitive with our neighbors. This will help with business growth which in turn fuels job growth.

I’ll also call for an immediate end to the pension tax and a reinstatement of the exemptions on private sector pension plans Michigan seniors had prior to 2011.

Our seniors worked their entire lives to enjoy their golden years. But now, because they depend on a fixed income, the burdens of high inflation rates hit them especially hard. They deserve immediate relief. The pension tax was ill-conceived from the start. It’s time for it to go.

The critics will ask how do I plan to “pay” for the tax cuts. _That is the wrong question_. Tax cuts allow individuals to keep more of their income. It’s not a cost to the government, but a savings to individuals.

To make sure that our state budget remains balanced as required by our constitution, I’ll work toward a _sustainable budget_ as proposed by our friends at the Mackinac Center. This would set a maximum limit on what the government can spend based on population and inflation.

That means, if we were to implement a sustainable budget today, we’d have a projected increase of 3.15% in fiscal year 2023 vs the more than 10% increase proposed by Governor Whitmer.

It’s important that we are prudent with our spending. I’m a working guy, not a millionaire. I’m certainly not a career politician who has gotten used to spending other people’s money.

**I have always operated within the confines of our personal budget. We manage our spending, and we save._That’s how the government should work too_. **

Governor Whitmer wants to go on a spending spree because revenues happen to be up. I believe Michigan citizens see her spending for what it is – buying votes in the upcoming election.

Let’s bring some common sense fiscal responsibility back to Michigan. Lower taxes. Limited spending increases to a sustainable level.

By doing this, we’ll not only fix Michigan, but we will make our state highly competitive when it comes to business and job growth.

Peter, if you agree it's time to Fix Michigan, please take a moment today to make a donation to my campaign.

$25, $50, $100 ... whatever you can do will help.

We can turn things around and restore common sense to the Governor's office.

Please join with me today. We can do this.

Sincerely,

Michael Brown
Republican for Governor

This will help with business growth which in turn fuels job growth. I’ll also call for an immediate end to the pension tax and a reinstatement of the exemptions on private sector pension plans Michigan seniors had prior to 2011. Our seniors worked their entire lives to enjoy their golden years. But now, because they depend on a fixed income, the burdens of high inflation rates hit them especially hard. They deserve immediate relief. The pension tax was ill-conceived from the start. It’s time for it to go. The critics will ask how do I plan to “pay” for the tax cuts. That is the wrong question. Tax cuts allow individuals to keep more of their income. It’s not a cost to the government, but a savings to individuals. To make sure that our state budget remains balanced as required by our constitution, I’ll work toward a sustainable budget as proposed by our friends at the Mackinac Center. This would set a maximum limit on what the government can spend based on population and inflation. That means, if we were to implement a sustainable budget today, we’d have a projected increase of 3.15% in fiscal year 2023 vs the more than 10% increase proposed by Governor Whitmer. It’s important that we are prudent with our spending. I’m a working guy, not a millionaire. I’m certainly not a career politician who has gotten used to spending other people’s money. I have always operated within the confines of our personal budget. We manage our spending, and we save.That’s how the government should work too. Governor Whitmer wants to go on a spending spree because revenues happen to be up. I believe Michigan citizens see her spending for what it is – buying votes in the upcoming election. Let’s bring some common sense fiscal responsibility back to Michigan. Lower taxes. Limited spending increases to a sustainable level. By doing this, we’ll not only fix Michigan, but we will make our state highly competitive when it comes to business and job growth. Peter, if you agree it's time to Fix Michigan, please take a moment today to make a donation to my campaign. $25, $50, $100 ... whatever you can do will help. We can turn things around and restore common sense to the Governor's office. Please join with me today. We can do this. _I’m sure you get a lot of emails, but this is so critically important. _

I’m going to let you in on a secret. It’s something I’ve picked up while traveling across the country over the past year.

See, 2021 was the year where Democrats showed America their true colors. We saw that they are uninterested in addressing the issues that really matter to hard working Americans. Instead, they only want to focus on their far-Left agenda dictated by people like AOC, Bernie Sanders and Elizabeth Warren.

**But, things are about to change in a BIG way.**

2022 is going to be the year of the RED WAVE. The American people have seen ENOUGH from the radical Left, and they are ready to kick the Democrats out of power.

Nowhere is that more important than in the U.S. Senate. The current Senate is divided between 50 Republicans and 50 Democrats. Kamala Harris is the tie breaking vote. **[If Republicans can flip just ONE seat in November, we can take control of the Senate and stop Joe Biden’s radical agenda in its tracks.](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-3i4y5-1ygnz-4qqlpo2/ "Republicans can flip just ONE seat in November, we can take control of the Senate and stop Joe Biden’s radical agenda in its tracks. The momentum is on our side. The Red Wave is building, but we cannot take anything for granted.

**I’m a fighter, and I’m not going to stop fighting for what I believe in.** That’s what I learned at West Point and during my time serving in the Army. It’s exactly what I did as your Secretary of State. Now, I’m bringing that same fighting spirit to my mission to help Republicans retake control of the Senate.

**[That’s where you come in. I’m asking you to make a quick contribution to help Republicans retake the Senate. Can you chip in $25 right now to help us kick the Democrats out of power?](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-3i4y5-1ygo1-4qqlpo0/ "That’s where you come in. I’m asking you to make a quick contribution to help Republicans retake the Senate. Can you chip in $25 right now to help us kick the Democrats out of power?")**

When I served as President Trump’s CIA Director and Secretary of State, we showed that conservatives can actually deliver results for the American people. Now, we just need to put America First conservatives back in power, and your contribution can help me do just that.

---

**[We cannot afford to come up short in this mission. With your help, we can change things in a BIG way and turn our country around.

Are you with me?

-Mike

# **Friend — Raphael Warnock has supported Joe Biden’s assault on America’s energy independence every step of the way. **

And he hasn’t said a word about Biden’s oppressive restrictions on new drilling projects. But now, Warnock is suddenly saying we should suspend the gas tax. **Why? Because it’s an election year and Warnock knows he’s in trouble. ** **Georgia will decide who controls the U.S. Senate — and it’s imperative Republicans put forward a nominee who can make this race about Warnock’s failed policies and hypocrisy.** I am that Republican candidate, and when I’m in the Senate, I’ll always stand strong for American energy independence. Friend, political experts across the board agree: **Senate control will come down to Florida – and with Val Demings statistically TIED in the polls with Marco Rubio, there is zero room for error.**

**That's why legendary Democratic strategist James Carville is ALL IN on this battleground race – and he's asking you to join him:**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41835953/330527199/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2416-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZWNiMWViZi05NzhlLWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fwqd3fGbbyP8QrK3d1NHHXVwazjNbqIA6AedIInEu3s=)
James Carville knows that with Florida's last Senate race having been decided by just 0.12% of the vote, and polls showing Val Demings within the margin of error, this race will come down to resources. **Marco Rubio is _already_ sitting on a multimillion-dollar campaign war chest, so every fundraising goal, deadline and donation to Val Demings right now is truly make-or-break.**
