| | | **February 15, 2022** |
---|---|---|---
| | |
### Securing the Promise of Liberty and Justice for All
[As we commemorate Black History Month](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15506.31650885.5633429.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftwitter.com%2fChrisVanHollen%2fstatus%2f1488689885871493123&redir_log=333851389816375), we celebrate the stories of so many brave, accomplished, and brilliant Marylanders and Americans who have made and continue to make historic contributions to our country and our shared journey toward a brighter, more just, and more equitable future for all. Our nation's history has been marked and made by giants like Marylanders Frederick Douglass, Thurgood Marshall, Harriet Tubman, and Benjamin Banneker and by brilliant artists like Maya Angelou, Langston Hughes, James Baldwin, Toni Morrison, and other Black Americans in every field of endeavor who changed our country and the world for the better. Their names, their legacies, and their writings should be known by every school child, and their contributions to our shared history should be celebrated as we work together to build a more perfect union based on freedom, equality, and justice for all. Earlier this month, I had the opportunity to celebrate the life and legacy of a Black American who fought the Nazis in World War II as a Tuskegee Airman and was one of the greatest fighter pilots of all time: the late, great [Brigadier General Charles Edward McGee](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15506.31650885.5633429.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftwitter.com%2fChrisVanHollen%2fstatus%2f1490489228676980741&redir_log=937994872633374). I worked with colleagues to recognize his heroism by authorizing his honorary promotion from Colonel to the rank of Brigadier General two years ago, and it was a privilege to join his family and friends at his memorial to hold up his story of bravery to all Americans. I also joined members of the Maryland congressional delegation and the Black History Promotion and Education Committee for a celebration of Black History Month this past weekend. That event featured a keynote address by Dr. Kizzmekia S. Corbett, Ph.D. on health equity. Dr. Corbett holds a degree from the University of Maryland-Baltimore County and is the former scientific lead of the Coronavirus Vaccines and Immunopathogenesis Team at the National Institutes of Health (NIH). Her research team at NIH played a key role in developing the coronavirus vaccine that is now distributed by Moderna and which has saved countless lives. She currently works at the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health. From securing Americans' voting rights to dismantling systemic inequities in many of our institutions, big challenges remain. But the stories of General McGee, Dr. Corbett, and many others who have helped steer our nation's course toward brighter days continue to give me hope. At the end of January, we learned of another reason to be hopeful. With the announcement of Justice Stephen Breyer's retirement at the end of this Supreme Court term, President Biden has committed to nominating a successor with extraordinary qualifications, character, experience, and integrity - and that person will be the first Black woman to sit on the High Court. [Justice Breyer has been a champion of equal justice under law](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15506.31650885.5633429.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftwitter.com%2fChrisVanHollen%2fstatus%2f1486414436663541761&redir_log=874979102782373). I'm thankful for his service and his deep understanding of our Constitution and the rights it protects. Now, I'm ready to get to work to confirm a justice who will continue to uphold these core values for all. That act is just one small but important movement in our ongoing mission to bend the arc of the moral universe toward justice.
---
### What We've Accomplished Together
President Biden was sworn in [just over one year ago](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15506.31650885.5633429.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftwitter.com%2fChrisVanHollen%2fstatus%2f1484249887596335105&redir_log=645832752894374). After his inauguration, we immediately got moving to address the health impacts from the COVID-19 pandemic and the economic harm it was wreaking. These twin challenges demanded a response that would help keep people safe while also providing an economic safety net to help the country weather the storm.

First, we passed the [American Rescue Plan](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15506.31650885.5633429.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-cardin-secure-maryland-funding-in-senate-passed-american-rescue-plan&redir_log=222465215255927), which brought historic relief to Maryland families, workers, and communities and gave our economy a boost that helped deliver record job growth accompanied by [unparalleled reductions in the unemployment rate](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15506.31650885.5633429.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftwitter.com%2fChrisVanHollen%2fstatus%2f1481079733450280961&redir_log=746571889436373). Through this plan, we delivered over $6.5 billion in direct relief with stimulus payments to 2.8 million Maryland families, supported thousands of local small businesses, and provided tax cuts to families with children in our state. We also secured over $6 billion to help Marylanders get vaccinated and to support our frontline workers at the state and local level. Resources from the American Rescue Plan are still reaching our communities, and I've been meeting with leaders across our state to highlight the important progress we're making on key issues thanks to those federal investments - [including money to close the digital divide and promote digital equity](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15506.31650885.5633429.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftwitter.com%2fChrisVanHollen%2fstatus%2f1482418865023991811&redir_log=937829055989373).

Following the enactment of this historic relief, we tackled a priority that has been talked about for decades but was never achieved until now: [comprehensive legislation to modernize our infrastructure](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15506.31650885.5633429.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-secures-key-maryland-priorities-in-infrastructure-modernization-bill-signed-into-law&redir_log=201171204781050). I was proud to fight for Maryland's priorities in the new infrastructure modernization bill and to vote to send it to the President's desk, bringing over $7 billion to Maryland over the next five years in direct investments to update our roads, bridges, transit systems, broadband, and more. That legislation also includes many provisions I've been fighting to pass through Congress for years, including a measure to protect transit workers and pedestrians. Late last month, I stood with members of the Amalgamated Transit Union and Maryland leaders in Baltimore [to highlight this victory](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15506.31650885.5633429.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftwitter.com%2fChrisVanHollen%2fstatus%2f1486471325698961413&redir_log=420218469981374) - and that's just one of the many accomplishments for Maryland that we secured in this landmark legislation.

In addition, we have continued combatting the COVID-19 pandemic and are pushing forward with readily-available vaccines, more masks, and more testing to help keep our communities safe. I'm especially pleased that the Biden Administration has made it easier than ever to access masks and testing. You and your family can now [order up to four free at-home COVID-19 test kits](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15506.31650885.5633429.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftwitter.com%2fChrisVanHollen%2fstatus%2f1484554066906816514&redir_log=078200379422374), with kits delivered directly to your door, and the Biden Administration also announced that it is making 400 million N95 masks available to Americans for free. I encourage every Marylander to take advantage of these resources as needed.

We've come a long way over the last year, but we still have much work ahead. Over the weeks and months to come, I look forward to meeting with community leaders and Marylanders from all corners of our state to discuss how we can continue our journey toward a brighter future. I had the privilege of speaking with a group of faith leaders from across our state at the beginning of January, and my conversation with them reaffirmed my conviction that it won't be enough for us to return to the pre-pandemic status quo. We must work together to strengthen our communities and bring shared prosperity and greater opportunity to all.
### Combating Fraud Against Maryland Seniors
Every day, Marylanders and Americans all across the country fall victim to con artists who target seniors. According to a report from the Senate Special Committee on Aging released last Congress, older Americans lose approximately $3 billion each year to financial scams and abuse. We've made progress to stop these schemes, but there's more we can do. That's why I've partnered with a group of colleagues to introduce critical bipartisan legislation to help combat fraudulent scams aimed at older Americans. Our bill, the [Empowering States to Protect Seniors from Bad Actors Act](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15506.31650885.5633429.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-scott-warnock-lummis-introduce-bipartisan-bill-to-protect-seniors-from-fraud%23%3a%7e%3atext%3dThe%2520Senators%27%2520legislation%252C%2520the%2520Empowering%2cregulators%2520to%2520protect%2520senior%2520investors.&redir_log=412227830821690), creates a partnership between the federal and state governments to protect senior investors from scams that target them.

Recently, I joined a town hall hosted by AARP Maryland to take questions from Marylanders on this legislation and other initiatives I'm pursuing to serve our seniors. I look forward to working with my colleagues to get this common-sense bill passed, and I am committed to advancing additional priorities to protect Marylanders of all ages and financial backgrounds from fraud.
### Preparing for Tax Season
With Maryland households now preparing to file their annual tax returns, my office has assembled resources to help answer questions in the lead-up to this year's federal tax deadline of April 18. You can click [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15506.31650885.5633429.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fconstituent-services%2ftaxes&redir_log=362462995145424) to view those resources, and I encourage folks with additional questions to [contact my office](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15506.31650885.5633429.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fcontact&redir_log=475918421268285). For many, filing their taxes - and receiving their refund from the IRS - can be a difficult process. That's why my office is here to help and can work to ensure you get the refund you're owed.

I also understand the frustration that some Marylanders are feeling as they continue to wait for their IRS tax refunds from last year. There is a massive refund backlog at the IRS, due in large part to outdated equipment that places unnecessary strain on staff and slows down efficiency. As the new Chair of the Senate Appropriations Subcommittee that oversees federal funding for the IRS, I have been working with colleagues to address this issue by delivering resources that will bring IRS taxpayer services into the 21st century by upgrading and replacing aging IRS infrastructure. For working families, that will mean improved service, shorter hold times when they call the IRS with questions, and a reduction in the massive backlog that has left millions of Americans in a holding pattern as they wait for their 2021 refunds.

Whether you have concerns about your 2022 tax return, are still waiting on your 2021 refund, or have additional concerns about tax season, I encourage you to reach out to my office. Maryland can only succeed when Marylanders work together in partnership, and my office is always standing by to assist with issues ranging from taxes to federal benefits programs to passports and more. My entire team is committed to delivering constituent services that meet the needs of all Marylanders.

Chris Van Hollen

clean_body: | | | | ---|--- | | | February 15, 2022 | ---|---|---|--- | | | Securing the Promise of Liberty and Justice for All , we celebrate the stories of so many brave, accomplished, and brilliant Marylanders and Americans who have made and continue to make historic contributions to our country and our shared journey toward a brighter, more just, and more equitable future for all. Our nation's history has been marked and made by giants like Marylanders Frederick Douglass, Thurgood Marshall, Harriet Tubman, and Benjamin Banneker and by brilliant artists like Maya Angelou, Langston Hughes, James Baldwin, Toni Morrison, and other Black Americans in every field of endeavor who changed our country and the world for the better. Their names, their legacies, and their writings should be known by every school child, and their contributions to our shared history should be celebrated as we work together to build a more perfect union based on freedom, equality, and justice for all. Earlier this month, I had the opportunity to celebrate the life and legacy of a Black American who fought the Nazis in World War II as a Tuskegee Airman and was one of the greatest fighter pilots of all time: the late, great . I worked with colleagues to recognize his heroism by authorizing his honorary promotion from Colonel to the rank of Brigadier General two years ago, and it was a privilege to join his family and friends at his memorial to hold up his story of bravery to all Americans. I also joined members of the Maryland congressional delegation and the Black History Promotion and Education Committee for a celebration of Black History Month this past weekend. That event featured a keynote address by Dr. Kizzmekia S. Corbett, Ph.D. on health equity. Dr. Corbett holds a degree from the University of Maryland-Baltimore County and is the former scientific lead of the Coronavirus Vaccines and Immunopathogenesis Team at the National Institutes of Health (NIH). Her research team at NIH played a key role in developing the coronavirus vaccine that is now distributed by Moderna and which has saved countless lives. She currently works at the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health. From securing Americans' voting rights to dismantling systemic inequities in many of our institutions, big challenges remain. But the stories of General McGee, Dr. Corbett, and many others who have helped steer our nation's course toward brighter days continue to give me hope. At the end of January, we learned of another reason to be hopeful. With the announcement of Justice Stephen Breyer's retirement at the end of this Supreme Court term, President Biden has committed to nominating a successor with extraordinary qualifications, character, experience, and integrity - and that person will be the first Black woman to sit on the High Court. . I'm thankful for his service and his deep understanding of our Constitution and the rights it protects. Now, I'm ready to get to work to confirm a justice who will continue to uphold these core values for all. That act is just one small but important movement in our ongoing mission to bend the arc of the moral universe toward justice. What We've Accomplished Together President Biden was sworn in . After his inauguration, we immediately got moving to address the health impacts from the COVID-19 pandemic and the economic harm it was wreaking. These twin challenges demanded a response that would help keep people safe while also providing an economic safety net to help the country weather the storm. First, we passed the , which brought historic relief to Maryland families, workers, and communities and gave our economy a boost that helped deliver record job growth accompanied by . Through this plan, we delivered over $6.5 billion in direct relief with stimulus payments to 2.8 million Maryland families, supported thousands of local small businesses, and provided tax cuts to families with children in our state. We also secured over $6 billion to help Marylanders get vaccinated and to support our frontline workers at the state and local level. Resources from the American Rescue Plan are still reaching our communities, and I've been meeting with leaders across our state to highlight the important progress we're making on key issues thanks to those federal investments - . Following the enactment of this historic relief, we tackled a priority that has been talked about for decades but was never achieved until now: . I was proud to fight for Maryland's priorities in the new infrastructure modernization bill and to vote to send it to the President's desk, bringing over $7 billion to Maryland over the next five years in direct investments to update our roads, bridges, transit systems, broadband, and more. That legislation also includes many provisions I've been fighting to pass through Congress for years, including a measure to protect transit workers and pedestrians. Late last month, I stood with members of the Amalgamated Transit Union and Maryland leaders in Baltimore - and that's just one of the many accomplishments for Maryland that we secured in this landmark legislation. In addition, we have continued combatting the COVID-19 pandemic and are pushing forward with readily-available vaccines, more masks, and more testing to help keep our communities safe. I'm especially pleased that the Biden Administration has made it easier than ever to access masks and testing. You and your family can now , with kits delivered directly to your door, and the Biden Administration also announced that it is making 400 million N95 masks available to Americans for free. I encourage every Marylander to take advantage of these resources as needed. We've come a long way over the last year, but we still have much work ahead. Over the weeks and months to come, I look forward to meeting with community leaders and Marylanders from all corners of our state to discuss how we can continue our journey toward a brighter future. I had the privilege of speaking with a group of faith leaders from across our state at the beginning of January, and my conversation with them reaffirmed my conviction that it won't be enough for us to return to the pre-pandemic status quo. We must work together to strengthen our communities and bring shared prosperity and greater opportunity to all. Combating Fraud Against Maryland Seniors Every day, Marylanders and Americans all across the country fall victim to con artists who target seniors. According to a report from the Senate Special Committee on Aging released last Congress, older Americans lose approximately $3 billion each year to financial scams and abuse. We've made progress to stop these schemes, but there's more we can do. That's why I've partnered with a group of colleagues to introduce critical bipartisan legislation to help combat fraudulent scams aimed at older Americans. Our bill, the , creates a partnership between the federal and state governments to protect senior investors from scams that target them. Recently, I joined a town hall hosted by AARP Maryland to take questions from Marylanders on this legislation and other initiatives I'm pursuing to serve our seniors. I look forward to working with my colleagues to get this common-sense bill passed, and I am committed to advancing additional priorities to protect Marylanders of all ages and financial backgrounds from fraud. Preparing for Tax Season With Maryland households now preparing to file their annual tax returns, my office has assembled resources to help answer questions in the lead-up to this year's federal tax deadline of April 18. You can click to view those resources, and I encourage folks with additional questions to . For many, filing their taxes - and receiving their refund from the IRS - can be a difficult process. That's why my office is here to help and can work to ensure you get the refund you're owed. I also understand the frustration that some Marylanders are feeling as they continue to wait for their IRS tax refunds from last year. There is a massive refund backlog at the IRS, due in large part to outdated equipment that places unnecessary strain on staff and slows down efficiency. As the new Chair of the Senate Appropriations Subcommittee that oversees federal funding for the IRS, I have been working with colleagues to address this issue by delivering resources that will bring IRS taxpayer services into the 21st century by upgrading and replacing aging IRS infrastructure. For working families, that will mean improved service, shorter hold times when they call the IRS with questions, and a reduction in the massive backlog that has left millions of Americans in a holding pattern as they wait for their 2021 refunds. Whether you have concerns about your 2022 tax return, are still waiting on your 2021 refund, or have additional concerns about tax season, I encourage you to reach out to my office. Maryland can only succeed when Marylanders work together in partnership, and my office is always standing by to assist with issues ranging from taxes to federal benefits programs to passports and more. # Treat addiction, don't fund it
---
| Sen. Marco Rubio of Florida, and Sen. Joe Manchin of West Virginia have introduced a bipartisan bill to inject sense into federal policy regarding illicit drug use. The bill, which I fully support, is called the PIPES Act--Preventing Illicit Paraphernalia for Exchange Systems Act. It would prohibit federal tax dollars for funding crack pipes and other drug related items for substance abusers.
Both senators acknowledged that substance abuse is heartbreaking but paying for addicts to be supplied with paraphernalia is no solution. Instead, we need solutions that treat the mental illness at the root of addiction, not enable it by handing out free paraphernalia.
The bill is in response to a report that the Department of Health and Humans Services submitted a grant application to fund the distribution of crack pipes. Furthermore, the Associated Press reported that the Department of Justice is open to allowing "safe injection sites" where addicts can use heroin and other dangerous drugs in a place where they can be protected against overdose.
Government support should not be given to perpetuate addiction. In fact, the idea that the government might do so is patently absurd. Every day it seems our Biden, Pelosi and Schumer led government is more detached from reality. Have we entered the twilight zone?
Shockingly, Colorado Democrats--led by my opponent in Congressional District 7--took action in 2019 to sponsor the first drug injection site in the United States right here in our state. And when common sense leaders pushed back on the potential bill, she called accused them of disseminating "misinformation." That's a political tactic to duck and run. Clearly, she's too extreme for Colorado. I stand with Senators Rubio and Manchin because I believe common sense must prevail in lawmaking. As a student of psychology, I will work for programs that treat addiction, not senselessly enable it. Send me to Washington to push back on Democrats and their extreme radical policies. Please donate to protect the safety of our communities and families. We can help those who need it without enabling addiction.

Hey Derek, If you listen to the conventional wisdom, there’s been lots of doom and gloom about Democrats’ chances this November. I don’t buy it. Sure, it’s not in my nature to give up, but it’s more than that. There are new signs that we can beat the historic trends. **One of the main reasons why the pundits were so down on Democratic chances in November was redistricting. The commentators all said that we would get crushed by GOP legislatures and that gerrymandering alone could cost us the House. It didn’t happen.** As a result of Democratic efforts to push back, and a string of recent court decisions in Ohio, Pennsylvania, and North Carolina that struck down extreme GOP gerrymandered maps, we now stand to neutralize any advantage Republicans had in this once-in-a-decade process. In fact, we might even come out ahead by a seat or two. Moreover, the current Omicron surge is coming to an end, and the country is returning to normal, with businesses reopening, and people going back to work. We still have to tame inflation and deal with supply chain problems, but our GDP growth is off the charts and the rate of unemployment has coming crashing down. But what provides me with more hope than anything is you, Derek. You’ve been fighting by my side and staying connected with our team for a while. There are millions of Americans who love and cherish our democracy, and they far outnumber those who are trying to tear it down. It hasn’t always been pretty. And with Trump, it’s been downright ugly. But the work of fighting for our democracy, and fighting to keep our majority is worth it. **Our success in redistricting, and improvements in the health of our nation and economy put us in a position to win, but only if we continue to recruit great candidates and make sure they have the resources to win. Recently, video hosting company JW Player refused to renew our contract to host videos—on PragerU’s own website! Later, we found out who was responsible for JW Player dropping PragerU as a client...online “fact-checker” NewsGuard. NewsGuard calls itself “The Internet Trust Tool.” It supposedly rates news websites for credibility and transparency. Even though PragerU is an educational nonprofit—not a news website—NewsGuard rated us anyway! [Give Today to Help STOP Fact-Checkers from Censoring PragerU!](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9lt9ue8bfgp3qmkknq7as7dkffaqi7certr0osg_rp22sh2s8i66ob1cjimaoj2cdh2bs) [**Donate to help PragerU fight Big Tech censorship!**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpidei54mpe6j32j3vqaqbu42kn8rbssbkv8grc0_rp22sh2s8i66ob1cjimaoj2cdh2bs) **PragerU’s scorecard (57 points out of 100) warning viewers to “proceed with caution”:** [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zi57ep0ep8s9j85a1i287jfkkg9l6l4p5jhsct2o_rp22sh2s8i66ob1cjimaoj2cdh2bs) Corporations, social media companies—even libraries—handsomely pay these third-party online nannies to label anything the left disagrees with as “fake news.” Hiding behind fact-checkers, they then deplatform or censor organizations like PragerU...taking zero responsibility for censorship! Upon learning of our abysmal rating that led to JW Player dropping PragerU as a client, PragerU CEO Marissa Streit contacted NewsGuard. **_"I am writing today to bring your attention to an urgent matter that I assume is a mistake by NewsGuard. Sadly, this mistake is damaging PragerU's reputation and costing our nonprofit millions of dollars."_ ** **—Marissa Streit, PragerU CEO** Marissa spoke with NewsGuard executive Eric Effron. He assured her that NewsGuard is unbiased and protects Americans from disinformation. Curiously, Eric didn’t seem to know much about PragerU (even though NewsGuard had already given us a bad rating). Over the next month, NewsGuard asked PragerU questions under the guise of improving our score. NewsGuard inquired about everything from why we don’t publish our donors’ names (which we would NEVER do) to our perspectives on COVID-19 and Planned Parenthood. Regardless of the facts and sources PragerU provided, our score wasn’t changed. They never intended to be fair. Clearly, NewsGuard simply thinks our values and ideas shouldn’t exist online. **_"The chain of emails we've exchanged with you and your team has exposed your organization for what it is—an online media bully run by wealthy left-wing activists pushing their agenda."_** **—Marissa Streit, PragerU CEO** This reality is...fact-checkers like NewsGuard are the political elite’s tool for censorship. Funded by giant corporations protecting their power and bottom lines, these self-appointed “Arbiters of Truth” are determining what is true and what is false. **Is this the America you want to live in? ** [**Donate to help PragerU fight Big Tech censorship!**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3e4sum7rmngqfv283kkaf1qcuum6s7jksjhrsio_rp22sh2s8i66ob1cjimaoj2cdh2bs) **PragerU is exposing NewsGuard and other fact-checkers for what they are...authoritarian oligarchs who monetized censorship to keep YOU from learning the facts and thinking for YOURSELF. ** PragerU needs your support to educate millions of young people about what’s really at stake—Freedom of Speech and Freedom of Information. At the same time, PragerU must diversify our platforms and develop alternative technologies to ensure Big Tech tyrants can’t silence patriotic voices. This is a time consuming and expensive endeavor! We need our loyal supporters to stand by us and give generously. We cannot do this alone. [Please give today to keep our videos reaching and changing millions of young minds!](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdb5rviqakhp38dhcpbtuctnl2n6vihslnrjljvo_rp22sh2s8i66ob1cjimaoj2cdh2bs) Your PragerU Team [**Donate now**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrfl6asi37hnn8neb572n26v72n5spsrboqbq5a0_rp22sh2s8i66ob1cjimaoj2cdh2bs) | |

body:
| I ran for Congress to represent my home community and work for the people of mid-Michigan. I grew up in Flint and was inspired to get involved in public service from a young age.

Before being elected to Congress, I created the Genesee County Land Bank, which helps generate local economic development, strengthen neighborhoods and reduce crime by redeveloping thousands of buildings. I also founded the Center for Community Progress, a national non-profit organization focused on attracting jobs and investment in older, industrial communities like ours.

**Serving my community is what I’ve always strived to do — and serving as your representative in Congress continues to be the biggest honor of my life.**

**Here’s the truth:** I’ve fought hard for the people of mid-Michigan — working to bring good-paying jobs here, rebuild our infrastructure, lower the costs of prescription drugs and ensure clean drinking water for all. I want to keep making progress for my constituents.

**But we’re up against a lot this November — because of redistricting, we’re running in a competitive, Republican-leaning district that is one of only a handful of races that will determine control of Congress. This will be my toughest race yet.**

## A full month!
---
It has been a month since I announced my run for Labor Commissioner! I don’t know about you, but I’ve had a full month. View some of [my press coverage here](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=620bc6fff1109d159fe9e6d8&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kullafororegon.com%2Fpress-coverage%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D620af0b12a422c16875f71cf%26ss_email_id%3D620bc6fff1109d159fe9e6d8%26ss_campaign_name%3DA%2Bfull%2Bmonth%2521%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2022-02-15T15%253A31%253A06Z&w=605f96f8c17ee25104ffec43&l=en-US&s=9iCL3e1VrFP9LCn5-1y1NfzYVbA%3D) and some of the [issues that I’ve dealt with at the county here](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=620bc6fff1109d159fe9e6d8&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.koin.com%2Fnews%2Foregon%2Fyamhillco-commissioners-to-meet-with-health-department%2F&w=605f96f8c17ee25104ffec43&l=en-US&s=muj-YXstuU_p1fhwwjAviM-sZKY%3D).
---
---
|
---
| _Also on this month’s ‘to do’ list: getting fresh head shots taken! Campaigns have a lot of moving parts!_
---
Now, with the Oregon Legislature in short session, I’ve been testifying in support of farm worker overtime, against easing restrictions on tear gas use, and in support of renewable diesel and expanding the responsibility of our state ethics commission. Coming up next week, I’ll be testifying on the importance of SB 1545, which **significantly increases slots in training programs and apprenticeships** for healthcare, construction, and manufacturing — all critical sectors of Oregon’s economy. **Supporting apprenticeships** is one of the three things that Oregon Labor Commissioner does. **Educating, investigating and enforcing civil rights and workplace rights** are the other two things. And, I’ve realized that many people have no idea (1) what rights they have and (2) where to go if their rights have been violated. On the first day in office, our team will have a plan rolled out to work with community groups to share the message of “ _you have rights; we protect them_ ” in every significant language, to every Oregonian where they live, shared by their peers. **We should expect a state where your civil rights are upheld** , regardless of whether you know them or not. It will take time, but we’ll get started. **I am so excited to be your next Labor Commissioner. **With hope,Casey Kulla
---
|
---

Remember to follow on social media, [donate](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=620bc6fff1109d159fe9e6d8&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kullafororegon.com%2Fdonate%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D620af0b12a422c16875f71cf%26ss_email_id%3D620bc6fff1109d159fe9e6d8%26ss_campaign_name%3DA%2Bfull%2Bmonth%2521%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2022-02-15T15%253A31%253A06Z&w=605f96f8c17ee25104ffec43&l=en-US&s=ojXrcjKFtp5MuFQE8SILDeINihk%3D), and [volunteer](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=620bc6fff1109d159fe9e6d8&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kullafororegon.com%2Fvolunteer%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D620af0b12a422c16875f71cf%26ss_email_id%3D620bc6fff1109d159fe9e6d8%26ss_campaign_name%3DA%2Bfull%2Bmonth%2521%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2022-02-15T15%253A31%253A06Z&w=605f96f8c17ee25104ffec43&l=en-US&s=nvMMOY3LEj3PzpyDvOMwYhQCMZM%3D)! We’ll be doing text-banking (it is easier than it sounds) and literature dropping in the weeks ahead, so join the fun!

Hi Derek — I’m Zoe, Chris is my husband (and truly the only man who could ever motivate me to write an email to a bunch of people I don’t know about Valentine’s Day).
Today is the 10th Valentine’s Day that Chris and I have spent together. Things definitely look a little different after a decade together. For starters, his hair is about 3 inches shorter since Chris and I met just weeks after he got out of the Navy, and he was basking in his freedom from the Navy’s haircut regs.
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41837739/330537577/-1668125556?refcode=fl_email_fr_20220215flowers_c_90da_xx_img1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YjRlMDlhOC05ZThlLWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RFmSypXdC5sq2e87zS05-givuaLkoaGl4RzzeHb5pXA=)

We’ve also since added three kids to the mix, which any parent can attest brings both new challenges and new meaning to any relationship. Sure, it’s much harder to just hop out for a date night on Valentine’s Day, but it also makes our hearts explode watching our kids excited to spread love to all of their friends and classmates. One of our favorite Valentine’s to date was when we were snuggled at home together just two weeks after welcoming our second daughter into the world.
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41837740/330537578/-1668125556?refcode=fl_email_fr_20220215flowers_c_90da_xx_img2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YjRlMDlhOC05ZThlLWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RFmSypXdC5sq2e87zS05-givuaLkoaGl4RzzeHb5pXA=)

Sometimes that may mean I’ll be spending Valentine’s alone on my couch watching Hulu, but that minuscule sacrifice will be so worth it if Chris can make even the smallest difference in the lives of people who need this country to do better.

In 2020, more than 45,000 people died from gun violence—numbers on the rise in large part because of the impact of the pandemic in this country.
#

Friends -
In just a moment, I am going to ask if you can please make your first donation to Giffords today. Please give me a chance to explain why this request—especially right now—is so important.
Here is the truth:
Since we started this work, we have passed 465 new gun violence prevention laws in states across the country.
Still, in 2020, more than 45,000 people died as a result of gun violence—numbers on the rise in large part because of the impact of the pandemic in this country.
So our work is far from done. In fact, it’s more important than ever.
Right now, we’re working in a number of states and in Washington, D.C. to save lives from gun violence. Many legislative sessions are just getting underway and we have a good chance to make real progress.
But I cannot do it alone. The gun lobby remains large and powerful. They’ve played dirty in the past and won’t go down without a fight this election year. There is only way we get it done, and that is together.
So I am asking:

Team, I'm sharing the good news that we met our mid-month grassroots fundraising target. Thanks to everyone who chipped in, we can continue organizing across our district and win this critical open seat for progress.
Maryland needs fresh voices in Congress who will deliver real results instead of empty rhetoric. In case you missed it, I was recently on MSNBC for "The Sunday Show" with Jonathan Capehart to talk about our people-powered movement to do just that.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lewis-msnbc?refcode2=body_video [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lewis-msnbc?refcode2=body_video]Click here to watch the segment >>> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lewis-msnbc?refcode2=body_link]
I'm proud of the work I've done in the Maryland House of Delegates to deliver for the people I represent, like banning solitary confinement for juveniles and pregnant women, funding a grocery store in a food desert, and getting the first cardiac care unit in Prince George’s County built.
I know that if enough of us pull together, we can win our June 28 Democratic primary, and I can do much more in Congress.
Let's keep moving forward,
Jazz

clean_body: This is an incredible move in the fight to take on incumbent corporate Democrat Henry Cuellar! | | | Hi Peter, it’s Regina, Jessica’s campaign manager. Did you check out Bernie Sanders’ email from yesterday? If not, we’ll fill you in: Bernie announced his most recent endorsement for Jessica! This is an incredible move in the fight to take on incumbent corporate Democrat Henry Cuellar! From Bernie to AOC, we have a lot of progressive champions backing our campaign. Because they understand that there’s power in numbers. The more progressives that are elected to Congress, the more we can win progressive policies like a Green New Deal, Medicare for All, and so much more! Thanks for all your help, Regina M. Campaign Manager Jessica Cisneros for Congress —---------FORWARDED MESSAGE—--------- From: Bernie Sanders Date: Mon, Feb. 14 Subject Line: My endorsement To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Hi Peter, it’s Bernie Sanders. Today, I’m proud to announce my endorsement for Jessica Cisneros. Jessica knows that real change comes from the bottom on up, not from the top on down. She will fight for the working class in Congress and together we will build a movement to transform this nation so that it works for all our people. With early voting already underway, now is the time to show that our movement supports Jessica today. Our progressive values are under siege from powerful interests. The gun lobby, anti-abortion rights extremists, Big Pharma, and fossil fuel giants are using their deep pockets to block progressive change in Washington and attack our rights across the country. During times like these, it’s important that TX-28 elects a progressive who will fight for them and their families — not corporate donors and special interest groups. The people of Texas’ 28th district are ready for change. They deserve a representative who will fight for working families instead of the 1%. That’s why I’m proud to endorse Jessica Cisneros for Congress. I’m confident that Jessica will uphold our progressive values, and treat health care, bodily autonomy, immigrant rights, workers’ rights, and economic freedom as human rights. She knows our diversity is our strength and that when progressives are unapologetic about our values and who we’re in this battle for, we win. subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
| _Sponsored by Hillsdale College_

| | [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=5a6051ba6380425fa995e284f7c1fc36&_e=ySSfcxXlZ4QHe1SgPbun4FAEwgbQuCW7P73uB7qUEhYLw3sjtqr0c32a2Beq09y6EI-Ye45lJoPT_8_d5SP5oKpcF_XrdN5jno9G0eC7Fc4d8xl0TWfCNhrf-gGueBeDURtD98IOeh9AKeYndHT-XotYhAk_w688yNVW2IvmcMENgkIRCPagGkMQvpU-2FkipgZYp3kGSwQnniza3AwOzTYgyQkcObDDHAYFISW8_hzATk5MGWry-r9aa1MHWuK5SzcKr0WwvoSKa-z49BRMHnHvCisIBhnIIFbpniekTQqtWWPqSGucL4kwxGqKKJW0S1ZkFNW0A4z6XZuQmWvzGJvuWImkz7qqxk9KyPhX3d9ATCa0yahUiVlKdyGo6hMmXjNYBk7m2xzI7ngFInMt4thOgzwN-YFWqUsKzY-6eQCU1T3J6noT4A-V6jKawxGa) Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.**

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=5a6051ba6380425fa995e284f7c1fc36&_e=ySSfcxXlZ4QHe1SgPbun4FAEwgbQuCW7P73uB7qUEhYLw3sjtqr0c32a2Beq09y6EI-Ye45lJoPT_8_d5SP5oKpcF_XrdN5jno9G0eC7Fc4d8xl0TWfCNhrf-gGueBeDURtD98IOeh9AKeYndHT-XotYhAk_w688yNVW2IvmcMENgkIRCPagGkMQvpU-2FkipgZYp3kGSwQnniza3AwOzTYgyQkcObDDHAYFISW8_hyMMV6PssJ2F55a3dQDSRezlQ5UWMCROeRinjj9neyMwvz4jKvdqxpF2UHjaMAXLtZLfjdGywnDii5cJHInIX1BN8XD8aM1s3wBqZDP3xjfJuGBWbEbOh7iDTjHbCOd2ZClnd_UTR84GIzngSun7Dc58oGYYJtXwoZUSR3IsibsrJ5zzL_QA1aa8B1TKND6D_OXS_uKdeNcdT0fqBhfswcZ)**

For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

**But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.**

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching _millions_ of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:

• **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
• **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
• **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
• **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
• **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

**And this is especially important in 2020, a critical year for America’s future.**

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using the secure link I’ve provided below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=5a6051ba6380425fa995e284f7c1fc36&_e=ySSfcxXlZ4QHe1SgPbun4FAEwgbQuCW7P73uB7qUEhYLw3sjtqr0c32a2Beq09y6EI-Ye45lJoPT_8_d5SP5oKpcF_XrdN5jno9G0eC7Fc4d8xl0TWfCNhrf-gGueBeDURtD98IOeh9AKeYndHT-XotYhAk_w688yNVW2IvmcMENgkIRCPagGkMQvpU-2FkipgZYp3kGSwQnniza3AwOzTYgyQkcObDDHAYFISW8_hxCqoCXofte5XkDq-UmmjfWzDvN1FD4VQa9yAcl5SumMxJwwJd0NxbdECc_8H3M1RbCR4_8bDkhyLz9TYA0ETrAYP-2YtbrQcLgFn9be98V7ssayDKnZoTiudLXg-lolBp2bWLPZ_gO7sXkbT8Jw_aczueBhoYTpdk-cx6xSsqVyuszVRIZeKylyM9Xpom0wZzrYAeT5LLiZtxex6w9Ilcy)**

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Peter, I am so proud of the hard work we have accomplished together, and I’m so excited to show y’all our newest campaign video:
[ | |
---|---|--- ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41840821/330551257/-963090601?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODk0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMTkwNzU4MC1hYjhlLWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OfnuOJqd05AiFK_jvq1XrByvjPwZPXuiKDKh_vO93bo=&emci=481820cd-a58e-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=f1907580-ab8e-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=23594672)
I met a lot of people in the last year of this campaign right here in Northwest Georgia. **The more people I talked to, the more I realized that my story _is_ the story of Northwest Georgia. **I grew up an army brat, traveling the country. It was hard on me and my family, but my father’s service was so important. I got pregnant at 18 and decided to keep my son – one of the best decisions I have ever made. But that was a decision I can’t imagine someone else making for me.

Things were hard and money was tight. Sometimes we had to get our next meal from the local food pantry. When I had my second child, my husband and I couldn’t afford childcare so we worked opposite shifts. We felt like strangers passing in the night. We never stopped working hard, but it took its toll. My husband struggled with alcoholism and luckily we were able to break past the stigma and get him the help he needed.

There were so many points where I could’ve given up, and I almost did. But we pushed through. **And just like all of you, I’m still standing. **

I’m running for Congress because it’s time that we invested in our rural communities – so that our kids can tell new stories, better stories. Marjorie Taylor Greene isn’t from our district, she doesn’t know our story and she hasn’t lived our struggles.

I started this campaign with $500 and a fire in my belly. I’m no stranger to having the odds stacked against me. And I will never stop fighting for my home. And I will never give up on you.

Today I’m asking you to have a little faith that tomorrow’s story can be better than today’s. **[I hope you’ll join us in this fight. ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41840822/330551258/-804235033?refcode=em0215&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODk0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMTkwNzU4MC1hYjhlLWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OfnuOJqd05AiFK_jvq1XrByvjPwZPXuiKDKh_vO93bo=)**

But we pushed through. And just like all of you, I’m still standing. I’m running for Congress because it’s time that we invested in our rural communities – so that our kids can tell new stories, better stories. Marjorie Taylor Greene isn’t from our district, she doesn’t know our story and she hasn’t lived our struggles. I started this campaign with $500 and a fire in my belly. I’m no stranger to having the odds stacked against me. And I will never stop fighting for my home. And I will never give up on you. Today I’m asking you to have a little faith that tomorrow’s story can be better than today’s. = Sincerely, Holly McCormack. | = | | | | | ---|---|---|--- Paid for by Holly for Congress Holly McCormack for Congress 862 Lafayette St PO Box 1035 Ringgold, GA 30736 United States If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please .

Let’s hear it for the Truckers! Courage is contagious, and whether it’s Truckers or Doctors who treat Covid and speak the truth, or people like Joe Rogan, we will stand behind them as the face down the tyrants who seek to subjugate all of us!

This week’s call to action is split into two parts – one set of actions today and another set of actions tomorrow. So, be on the lookout for part 2 tomorrow!

Finally, remember that the new tool we are using, AlignAct, allows you to email, sign petitions, tweet, post on Facebook, etc. with just a few clicks and a minute or two of your time. It makes it really, really easy and fast to complete multiple action items in a day!

**In this week’s call-to-action part 1:**
* RSVP for the GA Election Integrity Summit on Feb. 18-19
* Georgia Schools: Stop Masking Our Kids
* Other national AlignAct campaigns and action items

[](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._LV97JtOe6c2mi4nA)
In solidarity with the Truckers in Canada and America, we fully and completely agree: End all vax and mask mandates in America! As of right now, airplanes, trains, and buses are federally required to mandate masks for passengers and employees. There is also still a vaccine mandate for healthcare workers and federal contractors.

[**Use our AlignAct campaign**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.--ZYpFQ)**to contact the White House with just a couple of clicks and a minute of your time, to support the Truckers and end the mandates!**
[TAKE ACTION](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._yQ)
|

“The Biden administration is set to fund the distribution of crack pipes to drug addicts as part of its plan to advance "racial equity," the _Washington Free Beacon_ [reported](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) last Monday.

The administration went into full damage-control mode after the bombshell story broke. By Tuesday, the Department of Health and Human Services had issued a statement calling the claim “blatant misinformation,” while White House Press Secretary Jen Psaki [denied](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ0OTU0JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/XVWh82rjxEHdU6y41hdL4g) that crack pipes would be included in the safe smoking kits being distributed as part of a $30 million harm reduction grant program. Despite the denial, the Washington Free Beacon reported that it was told by an HHS spokesman that it "does not specify the kits' elements" but "only the parameters.”

Funding for the grant program is funded through the Democrat-supported American Rescue Plan Act of 2021. The taxpayer-funded grant also provides funds for syringes, fentanyl strips, vaccinations, disease screenings and condoms. The _Washington Free Beacon_ also notes that “President Biden's son Hunter is a longtime user of crack cocaine.”
|

**Audit Anthony Fauci
**
While millions of Americans lost their jobs, businesses, houses, and more over the last two years, Anthony Fauci did very well – he’s the highest paid federal employee and he had $10.4 million in investments in 2020! This information is almost impossible to get. It’s time to audit Anthony Fauci to find out just how much money he’s made off of the suffering of Americans.

[**Use our AlignAct campaign**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._UI0PEDFIq4XoAg)**to contact your US Senators and Representative to ask them to audit Anthony Fauci. It will only take you one minute to do!**
[TAKE ACTION](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)
|

Families in solid Red States might believe there is no way critical race theory would be taught in their schools, [but they could be wrong](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._L68Rnpqw1XjuGBtdQ). The Idaho State Board of Education is hosting a conference in June that will focus on addressing the threats caused by "Right-wing Extremists." Conspicuously absent in the program is any mention of left-wing extremism.

This partisan programming is funded by the Justice Department, where Merrick Garland is on a crusade against parents. These officials are targeting conservatives based on a toxic smear report by the Southern Poverty Law Center, which has a [long history](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ0OTU0JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/I5WT5z0Ces9JcmS0HB17MA) of lying about conservatives.

It is ridiculous that a governor who claims to be conservative has allowed this to happen in Idaho, but other states should learn from Idaho. It is easy to let critical race theory slip into curriculums if families aren't vigilant.
|

The great thing about using AlignAct to run our calls-to-action through is that they can remain up as long as necessary, and you can do them over and over again. Remember, they only take one to two minutes of your time, so you can take action on multiple campaigns every week!

Rep. Cori Bush, D-Mo., is refusing to back away from the "defund the police" slogan, despite pushback from fellow Democrats who fear that it’s poison at the polls. Spurred by the “defund” movement, liberal district attorneys in Democratic-run cities have weakened consequences for a range of serious crimes. Unsurprisingly, [homicides were up](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) 30% in 2020 compared to 2019, according to FBI data. The murder rate in 22 major U.S. cities was up 44% in 2021 compared to 2019 and 5% compared to 2020, according to a study from the non-partisan Council on Criminal Justice.

In 2021, the tide turned against the “defund the police'' movement with most Americans [supporting](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ0OTU0JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/Sh0jjERcCD3D9dYyBZv5Ig) increasing funding to help our brave men and women do their jobs. Instead of embracing these changes, the Democrats have effectively branded themselves as “the party for crime and criminals.” And that won’t play well at the ballot box this fall.

You've heard my frustrations with gridlock in Washington, but I wanted to stop and share info on a really awesome bill we just passed - the America COMPETES Act. Here in California prices have been skyrocketing - whether it's gas, housing or just everyday groceries. This bill tackles these high prices in a few important ways: First, it's going to bring down prices by streamlining our supply chain. It authorizes $45 billion in investments to make sure we're making what we need here at home and lessens our dependence on China. Second, it makes major new investments in domestic manufacturing to bring good-paying jobs back to places like the Central Valley. That means new high paying jobs for our workers and lower costs on everything from laptops to cars for our families. And third (this is the part of the bill I wrote), it expands apprenticeship programs so our kids have multiple paths to a great career. **This is the bill we need to bring down prices, turbocharge our economy, and ensure our kids are ready for the jobs of the future.** [**But we have to get this past the finish line. name: Danielle Allen
subject: Big news. And a bigger thank-you.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE COMMITTEE TO ELECT DANIELLE ALLEN
body:
Today, I announced I’m winding down my campaign for governor. And I want to say one thing: thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for everything you’ve done to support these efforts over the last 15 months.

---
| Hi Peter Willis,

Today, I announced I’m winding down my campaign for governor. And I want to say one thing: thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for everything you’ve done to support these efforts over the last 15 months.

I entered this race because I believe this is a time of profound urgency for the future of our constitutional democracy.

I believe that in the decade ahead we will, in Lincoln’s words, either nobly save or meanly lose the last best hope on earth.

And I believe that if we meet this moment, and step up to strengthen our democracy, we can build a government that delivers for our needs — one where all of us truly have a voice.

Over the last year-plus, our campaign has pushed that vision forward. And together, we’ve moved the dial on major issues for Massachusetts families — from bringing housing to the top of the conversation, to driving transparency in the governor’s office, to becoming the first gubernatorial campaign in Massachusetts history to call for decriminalizing addiction.

And in doing so, we made more history — as the campaign of the first Black woman to ever run for statewide office in Massachusetts.

As supporters, volunteers, donors, activists, friends, and family who stepped up to be a part of this big team of guts and grit and heart and hustle, you showed what it means to be the change our Commonwealth needs. I’m profoundly proud of, and grateful for, the work we’ve gotten done together.

Thank you for showing up in the many, many ways you did — to push for progress, transformation, and hope.

After a year of building grassroots momentum and progress, we hit a roadblock — a roadblock that I will be working to move in my next democratic reform efforts. Simply put, our current ballot access process does a disservice to Massachusetts’ history of leadership on democracy. Through both simple math in a winner-takes-all process, and limited engagement access for the broader Democratic electorate, the current ballot access procedure through the current caucus system is leading to a serious impoverishment of our democracy — fewer choices on the ballot, fewer non-traditional candidates able to enter the pipeline. As I reflect on my next steps for civic engagement, working on democratic reform in this area will be a priority for me.

I want to be really clear. My commitment to build transformation is unwavering. And I know yours is, too. There is so much work to do as a big, big-hearted team — to reimagine the possible, and keep building One Commonwealth.

I’m still in this work for transformation, and I hope you are too. I’m looking forward to continuing these efforts in the next iteration. Together.

Thank you for everything,

Danielle

**It's Time To Celebrate! **

**You're invited to the Jeff Warner For Congress
Campaign Kick-Off Celebration!**

160 Truck House Road, Severna Park, 21146
This is a time primarily intended to inspire, motivate and encourage you as you meet others who share our mutual concern for the direction of the District and of the nation. We'll share a pasta meal together, hear briefly from Jeff, and have a great time socializing.

Standing with you,

Jeff

One question...

Are you happy with the state of American politics today?

Every week hyper partisan politicians and talking heads attempt to divide us on one issue or another. This is leaving more and more Americans politically homeless.

Are you up to date on what **An America United** is doing to combat this?

**An America United was formed to help get our government working for us again by tossing aside toxic, divisive politics and focusing on conservative, common sense solutions that are proven to work. **

Governor Larry Hogan and An America United have been working with leaders from across the country to restore a big tent Republican party, advocate for smart solutions to our toughest challenges, and help build a network of Americans who are looking for a better way forward.

**Over the last year, Governor Hogan & An America United have:**
* Pushed for more funding & respect for law enforcement
* Led the charge to end gerrymandering
* Helped craft & pass needed American infrastructure funding & initiatives
* Fought against the radical Green New Deal in favor of common sense clean energy solutions
* Advocated for cutting taxes, good government, and smart solutions to turn our economy around
* Sparked a national effort to restore a big tent GOP

body:
Bill McSwain today announced his plan to restore law and order to PA at a press conference in NE Philadelphia. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/billmcswain/mcswain-announces-plan-to-restore-law-and-order?e=b1ec95759b)
---
| |
---
| **PRESS RELEASE
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
---
**February 15, 2022
CONTACT: Rachel Tripp
202.738.9089**
---
| |
# Bill McSwain announces plan to restore law and order as Governor
**West Chester, Pa.** **\-- **Bill McSwain today held a press conference to address the surge in crime in Northeast Philadelphia and across the city and to announce his plan to restore law and order as Governor. In his remarks, McSwain promised to take back the streets of Philadelphia from the rioters, looters, criminals, and gangs who have grown powerful as a result of DA Larry Krasner and AG Josh Shapiro's soft-on-crime policies.

McSwain, describing himself as the law and order candidate, spoke to crowds of supporters, local business leaders, and community members about his promise to restore Philadelphia to safety:
---
|
> **_"I am the law and order candidate for Governor. What the other
> candidates in this race know about crime, they read in the newspaper. I'm the only one who has done something about it. And I have a message for would-be criminals in this city: when I am Governor, I am coming for you. You will either obey the law, or you will go to jail – and you will stay there for a long time.
>
> As Governor, I will lead from the front. I am not intimidated by murderous thugs, criminals, or the woke mob. I will restore law and order to our streets and neighborhoods. That is what law-abiding Pennsylvanians deserve, and that is exactly what they will get with a Governor McSwain." _**
---
|
---
| |
# **MCSWAIN'S PLAN TO RESTORE LAW AND ORDER TO PENNSYLVANIA: **
* Implement bail reform with automatic pretrial detention for violent felonies. There will be no more revolving door criminal justice.
* Aggressively pursue the death penalty for anyone convicted of killing a law enforcement officer.
* Increase funding for local law enforcement and hunt down violent criminals by any means necessary, including the use of the State Police and the National Guard.
* Stop rioting, looting, sanctuary cities, heroin injection sites, as well as Joe Biden’s ridiculous plan for crack pipe giveaways. As U.S. Attorney, McSwain stopped heroin injection sites and guarantees that they will not exist in this Commonwealth when he is Governor.
* Create financial incentives to recruit new law enforcement officers and ensure financial security for current law enforcement families by giving them more pay, and a secure retirement.
* Lead the effort to pass a state constitutional amendment that the District Attorney of a city of the first class will be appointed by the Governor. There is only one such city in our Commonwealth, and it is Philadelphia. The time has come for this change. The Governor should have the responsibility to appoint the chief law enforcement officer of the largest – and now, the deadliest – city in our Commonwealth. That is how we will rid the City of Larry Krasner.

---
|
---
| The event was hosted by local business owner Anne Marie Muldoon, whose introductory remarks focused on the challenges she has faced as a business owner and community member as a result of Wolf, Shapiro, and Krasner's soft-on-crime policies:
---
| **_"I represent every woman who would take walks on her lunch breaks, or after work, and those who stop at a store on the way home. We cannot do that any longer. We are adjusting our lives for criminals, instead of the criminals adjusting their lives to the rule of law."_**
---
|
---
| McSwain's full remarks are [available here](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=0fd9ae99da&e=b1ec95759b).
---
|
---
| **BACKGROUND: **
Appointed by President Trump, McSwain's record as US Attorney demonstrates his fierce defense of constitutional rights, dedication to upholding law and order, and history of putting criminals and corrupt politicians in jail. Prior to becoming an attorney, Bill served as a scout/sniper platoon commander in the U.S. Marine Corps. He was born in Philadelphia and raised in Chester County, where he lives today with his wife, Stephanie, and their four children. More information on McSwain's background and platform is available [here.](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=52127f8950&e=b1ec95759b)

Team,
It’s officially campaign season in Michigan’s newly drawn 7th district! Recently, I launched my Snow Boots on the Ground campaign kickoff in the new parts of my district with one question in mind: what do these voters ACTUALLY want to see from their member of Congress?
It was a great weekend in Eaton County, Clinton County, Shiawassee County, and South Lyon in Oakland County. Friend, yesterday marked four years since the horrific shooting at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Parkland, Florida, where 17 students and educators – including my friend Fred Guttenberg's daughter Jaime – were senselessly murdered with an assault weapon designed for war. **Yesterday also marked four years of inaction in the Senate. **
---

It means the world to have Fred's trust and support in my race to defeat Marco Rubio. If you missed his message, I hope you'll give it a read below, because it's a story about why we urgently need to win this crucial battleground race so we can pass the gun safety legislation Americans desperately need. Friend,

We're approaching four years since my beautiful daughter, Jaime, was murdered in her classroom at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Parkland, Florida. No matter how much time goes by, she is on my mind every second of every minute of every day.
I had never spoken out about gun violence before my Jaime was murdered. I would never have guessed that gun violence could affect me and my family. But no one is safe from gun violence – and it hurts me to describe our country like that. So now, the work to end this violence – to spare other families this pain – has become my life's purpose and mission.
That's why I'm reaching out today. Just a week after my daughter was murdered, I confronted Marco Rubio at a town hall on gun safety. He couldn't even look at me. He refused to work with Parkland survivors to reduce gun violence. He refused to make it more difficult for people to access assault weapons like the one used to kill my Jaime, 13 other students and three educators. Marco Rubio failed Floridians.
I will do anything I can to make sure Marco Rubio is no longer able to fail our families and communities in the Senate – and there is no one better than Val Demings, a fierce advocate for gun safety, to replace him. Val Demings can win in Florida and expand our gun safety majority in the Senate – but the GOP is rolling out a full attack ad blitz to defeat her, so I promised I'd help raise $50,000 by midnight to make sure she can fight back.
**[Please, in honor of ending gun violence, will you donate $5 or more today to support Val Demings, defeat Marco Rubio and make real progress on gun safety?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41845379/330584803/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2427-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NzFiZDFhYi1jMThlLWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HEeTImwG-VoLi53-HxyPBIIpA4LZJwAGyhtbx-50hpw=)**
Throughout her service in Congress, Val Demings has made it clear that she is not afraid of the gun lobby. She voted to pass expanded background checks in the House, and I know we can count on her to continue fighting to end gun violence in the Senate.
Electing Val Demings in November would be a crucial step toward creating a gun safety majority that will enact the kind of real, meaningful change that is long overdue in our country – the kind of change that can save lives and prevent future tragedies. But Val Demings is facing an uphill climb to defeat Marco Rubio, which is why I'm personally asking for your help.
NRA-backing Republicans have already funneled tens of millions of dollars into Florida to back him, and this is only the beginning. If Val Demings is going to defeat him, it's going to take every bit of grassroots support from people like you and me. **[So please, can I count on you to donate $5 or more right now to help Val Demings defeat Marco Rubio and build a gun safety majority in the Senate? Every dollar truly does make a difference.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41845380/330584804/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2427-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NzFiZDFhYi1jMThlLWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HEeTImwG-VoLi53-HxyPBIIpA4LZJwAGyhtbx-50hpw=)**
By supporting a gun safety advocate like Val Demings, you're helping me honor my Jaime's life and memory. On especially painful days like today, that means more than I could ever express.

Thank you,

Fred Guttenberg

I would never have guessed that gun violence could affect me and my family. But no one is safe from gun violence – and it hurts me to describe our country like that. So now, the work to end this violence – to spare other families this pain – has become my life's purpose and mission. That's why I'm reaching out today. | Team, **did you know that your Arizona State tax form offers you an opportunity to donate to the Arizona Democratic Party?**

Whether you file the standard form (AZ Form 140) or the short form, please think about making a donation to the Democratic Party. _(This option is not available if you file the 140EZ form.)_

**_We made a record amount of money through the Arizona voluntary tax gift program in 2021_** and would like to see another record-setting year for donations through the state tax forms.

According to the Arizona Department of Revenue, the deadline for filing and paying state individual income taxes is April 18th, 2022. Here's how to find the donation lines on your 2020 tax form:

**AZ Form 140** \- Resident Personal Income Tax Form: _See lines 68_ – where you put in the amount of your donation – _and line 75,_ where you check the box marked Democratic.

**Resident Personal Income Tax (Short) Form:** See _lines 36_ – to write in the amount of your donation – and _line 43_ where you check Democratic.

As treasurer of the ADP, I can assure you that this is a GREAT way to donate to the party because it eliminates processing and bookkeeping costs! Plus, it saves you a stamp – and can make Tax Day a little less painful because you’ll be helping all Arizona Democrats.

Sincerely,

Rick McGuire
Treasurer
Arizona Democratic Party

body:
Time to get serious |
---
| | [ ](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=ea5ede1828&e=44b8c466b0)
---
| | Dear ,
As a father, I know what its like when children argue. One child might accuse the other of something. A typical response would be “Uh-uh, you started it!”

**This is about where we are at with the Democrats. They are trying to pre-empt and undo the work that we are doing for Election Integrity by framing it as us stealing the election – the exact same thing they are trying to cover up!**

_Let the gaslighting begin._

They are doing everything in their power to discredit and attack us because they are scared.

Just look at this headline –
---
| [ ](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=5eef091f6a&e=44b8c466b0)
---
| [ ](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=ed9cb9de54&e=44b8c466b0)
---
| How can they possibly write about Republicans “Starting the Steal” when Democrats are still covering up the last one?

It’s simple. The M.O of Democrats is to gaslight America. Masks. No Masks. No Vaccines. Vaccines. Elections perfect. Elections stolen.

**If they keep shouting non-sensical non-sequiturs at the clouds over and over again, eventually they will convince some people.**

_And the sad truth of it, folks, is that it works!_

**Americans are being blinded by the Democrats and we can’t let them win this time. We have to be louder, stronger, and more persuasive!**

_The Week_ reports as the main concern:

_What is the concern?_

_Acolytes of Donald Trump, galvanized by his false claims of voter fraud, are laying the groundwork for overturning future elections by commandeering state and county election systems. A major reason Trump failed in his efforts to overturn the 2020 election is that state and local election officials, many of them Republicans, certified the results over Trump's objections and threats. In response, Trump allies such as far-right nativist Steve Bannon have launched a campaign to replace principled officials with Trump allies, from the lowest county volunteer up to states' top election officials. Next time, the battered guardrails that held firm in 2020 might be gone, said Wendy Weiser of the Brennan Center for Justice. "This is a giant crisis," she said. "We've never seen anything like that before."_

**They claim that having election integrity patriots in office is a threat. When last cycle they had blatantly partisan, cheating, elected officials who blatantly stole the election for Biden.**

**_You can’t make this stuff up, folks._**

They put on blast anyone who remotely disagrees with them because it scares them and they are lashing out – like kids, they don’t know what else to do.

**Let’s be the adults in the room. We know what is best for America. We know the founding principles. Let’s lay down the law. Let’s send a clear message. Let’s make sure the whiny Democrats don’t get their way. Because when they do – we may never have safe elections ever again.**

[But to get our message out, to fight against the Democrats – that takes money.](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=8e3bbd3e84&e=44b8c466b0)

[Can you please help out with a generous donation today? I need your help to fight!](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=238622c7d6&e=44b8c466b0)

[Thank you for your support!](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=41de40167d&e=44b8c466b0)

The perfect

student loan debt.

and take action on student debt cancellation.

been sitting on his desk since April, that details President Biden’s
authority to broadly cancel student debt. This memo's information is
crucial to ensuring economic prosperity for millions who are drowning
under the student debt crisis.

We have to make sure that the President fulfills his promise to cancel at
least $10,000 of student loan debt — that’s the bare minimum.
