[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, if we want
to win a Green New Deal, pass Medicare for All, and cancel student loan
debt, we need to elect candidates who are ready to fight for working
people — not corporate interests.

That is exactly why we do the work of launching progressive primaries
against the Democratic establishment. While the Democratic Party is
beholden to massive Wall Street donors, lobbying from health insurance
companies, and pressure from Big Pharma and Big Oil, our candidates are
100% grassroots funded and always fighting for what the people need.

The Squad has proven again and again that they’re in this fight with the
people. Now, we need to make sure we expand the Squad, build our power in
Congress, and upend the status quo. That starts with electing Jessica
Cisneros and Greg Casar in Texas (early voting is underway!) and our full
slate of 6 Justice Democrats in 2022.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/94595?refcode=em20220215-21992&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=21992%2E1203867%2EG8IVyS ]Since our call for donations to the Primary Power Fund yesterday, 247
grassroots donors chipped in. Can you join them and help us hit 300
contributions before midnight? Every dollar we raise helps us against our
corporate-funded opponents in our upcoming primaries.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/94595?refcode=em20220215-21992&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=21992%2E1203867%2EG8IVyS ]Colorful sillhouettes of our Justice Democrats in Congress. Text: Chip
in to Fuel Progressive Primaries

With your support, we’ll elect the next generation of Justice Democrats to
challenge the corporate-backed Democratic Party. But we can only do it
with your support. Small-dollar contributions are what allow us to stay
strong and continue our work — so we can send 6 more JDs to join
Alexandria, Jamaal, Cori, and our bloc of Justice Democrats in fighting
for working people in the halls of Congress.

In Texas, our primaries are on day 2 of early voting and election day is
March 1. Victories in Texas could propel our fight to win 4 more primaries
this year and continue our project of transforming the Democratic Party.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/94595?refcode=em20220215-21992&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=21992%2E1203867%2EG8IVyS ]Chip in $3 or anything at all to help us hit our 300
contribution goal before midnight. Our work relies entirely on you, and we
need to start the 2022 primaries off with big wins.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/94595?refcode=em20220215-21992&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1005&akid=21992%2E1203867%2EG8IVyS ]Contribute $3

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1006&akid=21992%2E1203867%2EG8IVyS ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1007&akid=21992%2E1203867%2EG8IVyS ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

body:
Reproductive rights are under attack. We need to band together to protect the right to choose.
# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=105%2E61531%2E4wMTMm)
Hello,
Today, we’re honored to share we received the endorsement of NARAL Pro-Choice America as we fight to protect and expand reproductive freedom in Vermont and across the country.
For over 50 years, NARAL Pro-Choice America has led the fight for reproductive freedom, including the right to abortion. **Reproductive rights are under attack in America.** States across the country are passing blanket abortion bans, and the Supreme Court is poised to strike down protections from Roe v. Wade. We need to band together now to protect the right to choose.
The stakes for this election are high, which is why it’s so important we do everything we can to keep this seat — and the Senate — in Democratic hands. We need more progressive voices in Washington to ensure our voices are heard. I’ve always supported reproductive freedom in Congress — from fighting Republicans trying to defund Planned Parenthood to supporting the Women’s Health Protection Act which would protect the right to abortion.
The people hurt most by attacks on reproductive freedom are those who already face barriers to accessing abortion care. **That’s why taking immediate action is so critical.** We don’t have any time to waste with Mitch McConnell and his extreme Republican Senate colleagues doing everything they can to restrict reproductive care. We need to guarantee reproductive health care and access to safe abortions for people everywhere.
[**If you’re ready to support our efforts to protect reproductive rights across Vermont and the country, pitch in $15 or whatever you can now.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/1356?t=3&akid=105%2E61531%2E4wMTMm)

We’re asking for your help to close our February fundraising gap.
#

Now that we’re past the halfway point in February, our team sat down to take a look at the numbers, and to be honest with you, it’s not the situation we wanted to be in right now.
We’re more than halfway through the month, but we’ve only raised about 30% of our fundraising goal so far.
Let’s be clear — nobody’s panicking, and the sky isn’t falling. There’s still plenty of time to turn things around and get back where we need to be before the end of the month.
But we’re going to need to bring in a LOT of donations in the next few days to do it. What do you say?
[**Can you add a donation — of any amount — to help us get back on track to our February fundraising goal so we can send Alex back to the Senate and defend the majority for Democrats?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ap-em-feb22?refcode=em220215-1-30&t=1&refcode2=647_159979_Uar4F9&akid=647%2E159979%2EUar4F9)

From reforming our broken immigration system, to protecting the right to vote, to guaranteeing health care as a right for everyone — it’s incredibly important that we hold this seat in order to make progress on the issues that matter to Californians.
And to do that, we have to hit our monthly fundraising goals. Because a few lackluster months could leave us vulnerable to attacks from the same far-right Republicans behind the recall attempt last summer.
[**So if you can afford it, please make a contribution to Alex’s campaign today to help us close our February fundraising gap and ensure we’re ready for anything that comes our way.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ap-em-feb22?refcode=em220215-1-30&t=3&refcode2=647_159979_Uar4F9&akid=647%2E159979%2EUar4F9)
Thank you!
\- Team Padilla

Hi friend, I'm Nika, Max's wife.

You probably haven't seen much of me on the campaign trail, but I figured now is as good a time as any to introduce myself.

I was born in San Francisco and grew up in the Bay Area. Both of my parents are immigrants. My father was a refugee from Cambodia where most of his family was killed by communists. His parents had, wisely, sent him to boarding school when tensions rose. He never saw them again. He then met and married my mother -- a native of China's Guangdong Province -- a few years later in San Francisco.

Max and I met at Berkeley in 2010. We were in a coed international affairs fraternity, and we had similar majors -- Political Economy and Development Studies. He asked me out on a date. I said yes, and the rest was history.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41841888/330555588/360059203?refcode=em-2.15.22-nopen-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMTYyNzVlNS1iMDhlLWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qRuczoJUDKbLu1c4Umw6dQQ_8LKjW37SpVia5RPxdA4=)

Friend -- In case you missed it, ahead of Tony Evers’ final State of the State today, Republican Party of Wisconsin Chairman Paul Farrow penned an **[op-ed](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=5wg3don5l6_J12hXkf3HPcNYT6lUz2m18CPWRl8AJrxE2b_PUz7xxXYes4Kcm0oY06-ZedIuviZ4U5HkfZksew&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=farrow_sots_icymi_v1&n=2)** in Wisconsin Right Now highlighting Evers’ long list of failures. [](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=5wg3don5l6_J12hXkf3HPcNYT6lUz2m18CPWRl8AJrxE2b_PUz7xxXYes4Kcm0oY06-ZedIuviZ4U5HkfZksew&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=farrow_sots_icymi_v1&n=3) Read some excerpts below:
> _As Wisconsin has dealt with two years of historic challenges, Tony Evers has been asleep at the wheel. He has refused to provide real leadership while leaving the work of governing to liberal staff and political operatives in his administration, and on every issue that matters, Evers has chosen to serve the interests of the far-left – not working-class Wisconsinites._ _No one has had a stronger influence over Wisconsin’s education system in recent decades than self-proclaimed “education governor” Tony Evers – yet the state of our education system has reached a crisis. Despite over $5 billion in federal and state support added to Wisconsin’s education system in recent years, according to DPI’s own data, English language arts proficiency is down by over 16 percent, math proficiency is down by over 20 percent, and just 8 percent of Black students are proficient in math._ _[...]_ _Meanwhile, crime is rising across Wisconsin, and Tony Evers has failed to provide real solutions to keep the public safe. In October, Evers designated federal dollars (i.e. his taxpayer-funded re-election slush fund) towards some vague “violence prevention” effort. He announced it at a press conference that was interrupted by gunfire! And yet as of January 2022, none of that money had actually been spent._ _[...]_ _Small business owners and employees paid the price of Evers’ costly lockdowns that shuttered Main Street businesses for nearly two months. Now, after declaring over the summer that the outcry from small business owners didn’t constitute enough “proof” to act, Evers is standing idly by as national Democrats push vaccine mandates and other policies that are exacerbating labor shortages in Wisconsin and nationwide._
Republicans are working to ensure that Wisconsinites know the truth ahead of Tony Evers’ attempt to rewrite history tonight. You can read more from Chairman Farrow in Washington Right Now [**here**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=5wg3don5l6_J12hXkf3HPcNYT6lUz2m18CPWRl8AJrxE2b_PUz7xxXYes4Kcm0oY06-ZedIuviZ4U5HkfZksew&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=farrow_sots_icymi_v1&n=4) , or read our State of the State Preview press release **[here](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0Sl4u2LCpY4quBcdrSlEtsJFtzvw0cYXkEbVl0lKFzcgrXMcNN5QnhDgophShRXeUebaI82DvsmyB4XkyOcT8lE&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=farrow_sots_icymi_v1&n=5)**.__ Thanks,__ Anna Kelly

body:
This last weekend, I was in North Idaho, where I was able to visit with and speak to conservative Idahoans from across the region. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/janicemcgeachin/02-15-22?e=823fa8e224)

| | [ ](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=70d22c462c&e=823fa8e224)
---
| | Dear Friends,
---
| This last weekend, I visited North Idaho, where I was able to meet with and speak to conservative Idahoans from across the region. I spent time in Hayden, Sandpoint, and Coeur d'Alene.
---
|
---
---
|
---
---
| In Coeur d'Alene, I attended the Kootenai County Lincoln Day celebration with freedom lovers from throughout the state. It was wonderful to listen to Dinesh D'Souza, an influential voice for conservatives everywhere in our country.
---
|
---
---
|
---
---
| Across our northern border in Canada, there have been some distressing developments, with police arresting protesters and seizing their property for taking a stand against dehumanizing vaccine mandates. Things escalated further yesterday with Prime Minister Justin Trudeau invoking Canada's "Emergencies Act," for the first time in the country's history, reportedly so the government can seize the bank accounts of those participating in and assisting the Freedom Convoy. Trudeau's unthinkable overreach has been widely condemned by voices across the political spectrum with the Canadian Civil Liberties Association saying his unprecedented power grab "threatens our democracy and our civil liberties." Meanwhile, in California, celebrities and politicians who attended the Super Bowl unmasked seem to feel no shame for continuing to force children to wear masks even though there is no evidence that doing so provides any benefit and mounting proof that it does considerable harm. **Did you know that multiple Idaho school districts are still forcing children to wear masks?** It's almost unbelievable, but it's true. Thanks to the ongoing failure of leadership demonstrated by Brad Little, thousands of Idaho children continue to suffer needlessly. Under a McGeachin administration, this abuse will end — and never be repeated!
---

Janice McGeachin for Idaho Governor

Hey friends,

I’m proud to endorse Mike Durant for U.S. Senate.
[](http://links.durantforsenate.com/u/click?_t=02743ebc773d4d56aaad0942d1097fe3&_m=95873f91012348869c4d3cbe441829a4&_e=54ewwJAa-PjuBxS3q57bDf7ldAdUR37uQynBwkm9V67UqnA8Ais2tsmfHnQoTv3DL7WEUIFFAxWLA9_aQIBDYa5aR49MmzYrBw_u7LSRnoNlsJOikZYX7fOlAQG_luqxKUqWHd6shGhOQH9kSb3IJ5UglvrE0gQjw0Sk3CfhiQ2LtxKDFbD18melXC9g9Y_kqtptiBwnLd6qcUlubEjtAswjBQlx2X3-ve-K32zk8vMGBUm4p5lD845kY5xQvpH_TkEucvQ7_nyxBaT5Y9MRqukqskKJkG3y3AUlRnmRTrF1fA2cbRRcYLJhnpu3dZ4lDw8QpRAexmyRkRMKPqYhhrOjR1DFtWOR4RrPRQ1kCZHB--QCS3RINLvUxODOsU2eD_3vOPhRq2g0w7ZWg8vv29PsTFWS3opAME8ZcRkfAEEiwNPFpEiwbgdepTVVhzi4WUnmUuQ4A1olwxWSec_wXzETkRXNgWOI_6_dEJyNwl6nZfcuAgSJeja54R0uUvz-8jWFJaJqsZluskZ7nPvqRg%3D%3D)

I ran for office because we need more political outsiders who will stand up to the radical left and career politicians. Mike Durant is the political outsider that Alabama needs in Washington, and I am proud to endorse his campaign for United States Senate. Mike has spent his life serving our country and building a successful business.

Like President Trump, Mike will use his business experience and outsider perspective to deliver for Alabama and drain the swamp. I look forward to supporting Mike’s campaign and sending him to Washington for one more mission.

Mike is a conservative, a patriot, a business owner, a father, and a job creator. He’s exactly what Alabama needs.

**Will you join me in supporting Mike Durant for Senate?**
| [**SUPPORT MIKE DURANT**](http://links.durantforsenate.com/u/click?_t=02743ebc773d4d56aaad0942d1097fe3&_m=95873f91012348869c4d3cbe441829a4&_e=54ewwJAa-PjuBxS3q57bDf7ldAdUR37uQynBwkm9V67UqnA8Ais2tsmfHnQoTv3DL7WEUIFFAxWLA9_aQIBDYa5aR49MmzYrBw_u7LSRnoNlsJOikZYX7fOlAQG_luqxKUqWHd6shGhOQH9kSb3IJ5UglvrE0gQjw0Sk3CfhiQ2LtxKDFbD18melXC9g9Y_kqtptiBwnLd6qcUlubEjtAswjBQlx2X3-ve-K32zk8vMGBUm4p5lD845kY5xQvpH_TkEucvQ7_nyxBaT5Y9MRqukqskKJkG3y3AUlRnmRTrF1fA2cbRRcYLJhnpu3dZ4lUXwqDSfV5-bOzznydar0va8vIobyzl60Y1FbfVvjfdUy2W-w0WchcApoXNrawKWn50G--TSOOu0T3NAg_Z7cWulqO4NVdTbQivaBlHfs1Wevy46_O0GyXyBym_MDparcZJPhOBEeJZlKaBTEkNzB2isVgZCZ67I7mJPrKAq-PSQaMdbg1U3pF2dHGIF0i7RelPcFLt9Bz5v7b4HuhEnUcg%3D%3D)
---

Alabama needs a proven leader who is grounded in faith and patriotism.**I am confident that leader is Mike Durant.**

Mike’s story is one of courage and sacrifice. Mike served for 22 years in the Army. as a Black Hawk helicopter pilot. You might recognize his story from the movie _Black Hawk Down_.

In October 1993, during combat Operation Gothic Serpent in Somalia, Mike’s helicopter was hit by an RPG and crashed in the city. Mike and his crew fought for their lives as a violent mob approached. Witnessing what was about to happen from above, two members of the elite Special Operations unit Delta Force – MSG Gary Gordon and SFC Randy Shughart – volunteered to be inserted to defend them. They too were eventually overcome by the mob.

But Mike Durant, somehow survived, was captured and held as a POW by Somali General Mohamed Farrah Aidid. The heroic actions of Gordon and Shughart are the reason Mike is alive today. Mike has seen sacrifice – fellow service members who put honor, country, and mission above all else. He knows firsthand that the United States leaves no one behind.

**Now, Mike is signing up for one more tour of duty to serve his country and Alabama in the United States Senate.**

I’m confident that Mike Durant will protect life, defend the Second Amendment, support our veterans, and advance a 100% America First agenda.
_**Join me in supporting Mike Durant today.**_

clean_body: He's the right choice for Alabama | Hey friends, I’m proud to endorse Mike Durant for U.S. Senate. I ran for office because we need more political outsiders who will stand up to the radical left and career politicians. Mike Durant is the political outsider that Alabama needs in Washington, and I am proud to endorse his campaign for United States Senate. Mike has spent his life serving our country and building a successful business. Like President Trump, Mike will use his business experience and outsider perspective to deliver for Alabama and drain the swamp. I look forward to supporting Mike’s campaign and sending him to Washington for one more mission. Mike is a conservative, a patriot, a business owner, a father, and a job creator. He’s exactly what Alabama needs. Will you join me in supporting Mike Durant for Senate? | Alabama needs a proven leader who is grounded in faith and patriotism.I am confident that leader is Mike Durant. Mike’s story is one of courage and sacrifice. Mike served for 22 years in the Army. as a Black Hawk helicopter pilot. You might recognize his story from the movie Black Hawk Down. In October 1993, during combat Operation Gothic Serpent in Somalia, Mike’s helicopter was hit by an RPG and crashed in the city. Mike and his crew fought for their lives as a violent mob approached. Witnessing what was about to happen from above, two members of the elite Special Operations unit Delta Force – MSG Gary Gordon and SFC Randy Shughart – volunteered to be inserted to defend them. They too were eventually overcome by the mob. But Mike Durant, somehow survived, was captured and held as a POW by Somali General Mohamed Farrah Aidid. The heroic actions of Gordon and Shughart are the reason Mike is alive today. Mike has seen sacrifice – fellow service members who put honor, country, and mission above all else. He knows firsthand that the United States leaves no one behind. Now, Mike is signing up for one more tour of duty to serve his country and Alabama in the United States Senate. I’m confident that Mike Durant will protect life, defend the Second Amendment, support our veterans, and advance a 100% America First agenda.
